name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.Palomar.primePower_interval_bound_optimal
statement:
theorem primePower_interval_bound_optimal (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] (H : Subgroup G), H.index = p ^ a →
      Nat.card (Set.Ici H) ≤ totalQBinom p a) ∧
    Nat.card
        (Set.Ici (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))) =
      totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    (SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.primePower_interval_bound_optimal p a)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.Palomar.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_displayed_ratio_tendsto_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_displayed_ratio_tendsto_sharpConstant
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (Nat.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) /
        (((⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index : ℝ) ^
          (indexLog p
            (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index / 4)))
      atTop (nhds (sharpConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    (SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_displayed_ratio_tendsto_sharpConstant
      (p := p))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.Palomar.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_finiteUQ_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_finiteUQ_tendsto_one
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (Nat.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) /
        (((finiteUQ
          (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index p : ℚ) : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    (SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_finiteUQ_tendsto_one
      (p := p))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.Palomar.manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_positive_elementaryAbelian_bound
statement:
theorem manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_positive_elementaryAbelian_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a →
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
        (Nat.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    sharpConstant (p : ℝ) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_positive_elementaryAbelian_bound
    (p := p) (C := C)
  intro a ha
  simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hC a ha

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.Palomar.manuscript_no_subquarter_positive_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
statement:
theorem manuscript_no_subquarter_positive_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha : alpha < 1 / 4) :
    ¬ ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a →
      (Nat.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) ≤
        C * Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (4 * alpha * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    (SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_no_subquarter_positive_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
      (p := p) (alpha := alpha) (C := C) halpha)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gammaR_zero (p : ℝ) : gammaR p 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [gammaR]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_succ
statement:
theorem gammaR_succ (p : ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    gammaR p (r + 1) = gammaR p r * (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [gammaR, Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_pos
statement: theorem gammaR_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (r : ℕ) : 0 < gammaR p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaR]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j hj
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_trans (by norm_num) hp
  have hinv : p⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hp
  exact sub_pos.mpr (pow_lt_one₀ (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le hinv (by omega))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_le_one
statement: theorem gammaR_le_one {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (r : ℕ) : gammaR p r ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_trans (by norm_num) hp
  rw [gammaR]
  apply Finset.prod_le_one
  · intro j hj
    exact (sub_pos.mpr <| pow_lt_one₀ (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le
      (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hp) (by omega)).le
  · intro j hj
    have : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) := pow_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le _
    linarith

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_antitone
statement: theorem gammaR_antitone {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) : Antitone (gammaR p)
proof:
:= by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro r
  rw [gammaR_succ]
  apply mul_le_of_le_one_right (gammaR_pos hp r).le
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_trans (by norm_num) hp
  exact sub_le_self 1 (pow_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le _)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qWeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qWeight_zero : qWeight 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [qWeight]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qWeight_succ
statement: theorem qWeight_succ (r : ℕ) : qWeight (r + 1) = qWeight r + (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qWeight, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qWeight_split
statement:
theorem qWeight_split : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, k ≤ n →
    qWeight n = qWeight k + qWeight (n - k) + k * (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst k
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
          have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
          rw [qWeight_succ, qWeight_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, ih hkn]
          have hn : n + 1 = (k + 1) + (n - k) := by omega
          rw [hn]
          ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.cast_qpow_sub_one_factor
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : 1 ≤ q ^ (m + 1) := one_le_pow₀ hq
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hpow, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_pow]
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  rw [inv_pow]
  field_simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qFactorial_cast_real_eq_pow_mul_gammaR
statement:
theorem qFactorial_cast_real_eq_pow_mul_gammaR {q r : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (qFactorial q r : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight r * gammaR (q : ℝ) r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [qFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, ih, qWeight_succ, gammaR_succ,
        cast_qpow_sub_one_factor hq, pow_add]
      ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_cast_real_eq_gammaR
statement:
theorem qBinom_cast_real_eq_gammaR {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (qBinom q n k : ℝ) =
      (q : ℝ) ^ (k * (n - k)) * gammaR (q : ℝ) n /
        (gammaR (q : ℝ) k * gammaR (q : ℝ) (n - k))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  have hreal : (qBinom q n k : ℝ) * (qFactorial q k : ℝ) *
      (qFactorial q (n - k) : ℝ) = (qFactorial q n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  rw [qFactorial_cast_real_eq_pow_mul_gammaR (by omega),
    qFactorial_cast_real_eq_pow_mul_gammaR (by omega),
    qFactorial_cast_real_eq_pow_mul_gammaR (by omega)] at hreal
  have hsplit := qWeight_split hk
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  have hpow : (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight n =
      ((q : ℝ) ^ qWeight k * (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight (n - k)) *
        (q : ℝ) ^ (k * (n - k)) := by
    rw [hsplit, pow_add, pow_add]
  have hden : gammaR (q : ℝ) k * gammaR (q : ℝ) (n - k) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (gammaR_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < q)) k))
      (ne_of_gt (gammaR_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < q)) (n - k)))
  apply (eq_div_iff hden).2
  have hpowers : (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight k * (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight (n - k) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hq0) (pow_ne_zero _ hq0)
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hpowers
  calc
    ((q : ℝ) ^ qWeight k * (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight (n - k)) *
          ((qBinom q n k : ℝ) *
            (gammaR (q : ℝ) k * gammaR (q : ℝ) (n - k))) =
        (qBinom q n k : ℝ) *
          ((q : ℝ) ^ qWeight k * gammaR (q : ℝ) k) *
          ((q : ℝ) ^ qWeight (n - k) * gammaR (q : ℝ) (n - k)) := by ring
    _ = (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight n * gammaR (q : ℝ) n := hreal
    _ = ((q : ℝ) ^ qWeight k * (q : ℝ) ^ qWeight (n - k)) *
          ((q : ℝ) ^ (k * (n - k)) * gammaR (q : ℝ) n) := by
      rw [hpow]
      ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameWeight_zero
statement: @[simp] private theorem frameWeight_zero : frameWeight 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [frameWeight]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameWeight_succ
statement:
private theorem frameWeight_succ (r : ℕ) :
    frameWeight (r + 1) = frameWeight r + r
proof:
:= by
  simp [frameWeight, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameWeight_add_qWeight
statement:
private theorem frameWeight_add_qWeight (r : ℕ) :
    frameWeight r + qWeight r = r * r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [frameWeight_succ, qWeight_succ]
      calc
        frameWeight r + r + (qWeight r + (r + 1)) =
            (frameWeight r + qWeight r) + (2 * r + 1) := by ring
        _ = r * r + (2 * r + 1) := by rw [ih]
        _ = (r + 1) * (r + 1) := by ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.framePower_cast_real
statement:
private theorem framePower_cast_real {p r : ℕ} :
    (framePower p r : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) ^ frameWeight r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [framePower_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, ih, frameWeight_succ, pow_add]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameProd_diagonal_cast_real_eq_gammaR
statement:
theorem frameProd_diagonal_cast_real_eq_gammaR {p r : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (frameProd p r r : ℝ) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (r * r) * gammaR (p : ℝ) r
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := p) (n := r) (k := r) (le_refl r)
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, qFactorial_zero, mul_one] at hdiag
  have hreal : (frameProd p r r : ℝ) =
      (framePower p r : ℝ) * (qFactorial p r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdiag
  rw [hreal, framePower_cast_real,
    qFactorial_cast_real_eq_pow_mul_gammaR (by omega), ← mul_assoc,
    ← pow_add, frameWeight_add_qWeight]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_orderedBases_fin_zmod_cast_eq_gammaR
statement:
theorem card_orderedBases_fin_zmod_cast_eq_gammaR (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames (ZMod p) (Fin r → ZMod p) r) : ℝ) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (r * r) * gammaR (p : ℝ) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_orderedBases_fin_zmod]
  exact frameProd_diagonal_cast_real_eq_gammaR (Nat.Prime.two_le (Fact.out : p.Prime))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.span_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent_fin_zmod
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent_fin_zmod (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (s : Fin r → (Fin r → ZMod p)) :
    Submodule.span (ZMod p) (Set.range s) = ⊤ ↔
      LinearIndependent (ZMod p) s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hspan
    apply linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank
    · rw [hspan]
    · simp
  · intro hs
    exact hs.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by simp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.span_toAddSubgroup_eq_addClosure_zmod
statement:
theorem span_toAddSubgroup_eq_addClosure_zmod {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod p) V] (s : Set V) :
    (Submodule.span (ZMod p) s).toAddSubgroup = AddSubgroup.closure s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hspan : Submodule.span (ZMod p) s ≤
        addSubgroupAsZModSubmodule (AddSubgroup.closure s) :=
      Submodule.span_le.mpr AddSubgroup.subset_closure
    intro x hx
    exact hspan hx
  · rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    intro x hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span hx

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.addClosure_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top_zmod
statement:
theorem addClosure_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top_zmod {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod p) V] (s : Set V) :
    AddSubgroup.closure s = ⊤ ↔ Submodule.span (ZMod p) s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_toAddSubgroup_eq_addClosure_zmod (p := p) s]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Submodule.toAddSubgroup_injective
    simpa using h
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.addClosure_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent_fin_zmod
statement:
theorem addClosure_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent_fin_zmod
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (s : Fin r → (Fin r → ZMod p)) :
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range s) = ⊤ ↔ LinearIndependent (ZMod p) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [addClosure_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top_zmod (p := p) (Set.range s),
    span_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent_fin_zmod p r s]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_generatingFrames_fin_zmod_cast_eq_gammaR
statement:
theorem card_generatingFrames_fin_zmod_cast_eq_gammaR (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (Nat.card (GeneratingFramesFinZMod p r) : ℝ) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (r * r) * gammaR (p : ℝ) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (generatingFramesEquivOrderedBasesFinZMod p r)]
  exact card_orderedBases_fin_zmod_cast_eq_gammaR p r

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_inv_tendsto
statement:
theorem gammaR_inv_tendsto {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℕ ↦ (gammaR p r)⁻¹) atTop (nhds (eulerC p))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [gammaR, Finset.prod_inv_distrib] using eulerC_partial_tendsto hp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_tendsto
statement:
theorem gammaR_tendsto {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (gammaR p) atTop (nhds (eulerC p)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hp).inv₀ (ne_of_gt (eulerC_pos hp))
  simpa using h

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianRight_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianRight_eq {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hj : j ≤ a) :
    normalizedGaussianRight p a j =
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ * (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedGaussianRight, if_pos hj,
    qBinom_cast_real_eq_gammaR hp (by omega : a + j ≤ 2 * a)]
  have hsub : 2 * a - (a + j) = a - j := by omega
  rw [hsub]
  have hexp : a * a = j * j + (a + j) * (a - j) := by
    have := Nat.sub_add_cancel hj
    nlinarith
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
  have hscale : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
      (p : ℝ) ^ ((a + j) * (a - j)) = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := by
    rw [hexp, pow_add]
    simp [inv_pow, hp0]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
  calc
    (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
          ((p : ℝ) ^ ((a + j) * (a - j)) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
            ((gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹)) =
        ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
          (p : ℝ) ^ ((a + j) * (a - j))) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by rw [hscale]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tendsto_double_nat_atTop
statement:
private theorem tendsto_double_nat_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ 2 * a) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_atTop]
  intro b
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop b] with a ha
  omega

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianRight_tendsto
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianRight_tendsto {p j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ normalizedGaussianRight p a j) atTop
      (nhds (eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have htwo := (gammaR_tendsto hpR).comp tendsto_double_nat_atTop
  have hplus := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat j)
  have hminus := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR).comp (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat j)
  have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)) atTop
      (nhds ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j))) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have hprod := ((hc.mul htwo).mul hplus).mul hminus
  have hC0 : eulerC (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (eulerC_pos hpR)
  convert hprod.congr' ?_ using 1
  · field_simp
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop j] with a ha
    rw [normalizedGaussianRight_eq hp ha]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianRight_nonneg
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianRight_nonneg {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ normalizedGaussianRight p a j
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedGaussianRight
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · exact le_rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianRight_le
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianRight_le {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    normalizedGaussianRight p a j ≤
      eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j ≤ a
  · rw [normalizedGaussianRight_eq hp hj]
    have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p)
    have hpow : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith)) _
    have hgam : 0 ≤ gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) := (gammaR_pos hp1 _).le
    have hplus : 0 ≤ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ :=
      (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 _)).le
    have hminus : 0 ≤ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ :=
      (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 _)).le
    calc
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ * (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ ≤
          (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * 1 *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_le_one hp1 _) hpow) hplus)
          hminus
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * 1 * eulerC (p : ℝ) *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR _).le
            (mul_nonneg hpow zero_le_one)) hminus
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * 1 * eulerC (p : ℝ) *
            eulerC (p : ℝ) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR _).le
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hpow zero_le_one) (eulerC_pos hpR).le)
      _ = eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := by ring
  · rw [normalizedGaussianRight, if_neg hj]
    positivity

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianRight_le_eulerC
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianRight_le_eulerC {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    normalizedGaussianRight p a j ≤
      eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j ≤ a
  · rw [normalizedGaussianRight_eq hp hj]
    have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p)
    have hpow : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := by positivity
    have hpluspos : 0 < gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j) := gammaR_pos hp1 _
    have hratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ :=
      mul_nonneg (gammaR_pos hp1 _).le (inv_pos.mpr hpluspos).le
    have hratio : gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact (div_le_one hpluspos).2 (gammaR_antitone hp1 (by omega))
    have hminus : 0 ≤ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ :=
      (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 _)).le
    calc
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ =
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹) *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by ring
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * 1 *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio hpow) hminus
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) * 1 * eulerC (p : ℝ) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR _).le
          (mul_nonneg hpow zero_le_one)
      _ = eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := by ring
  · rw [normalizedGaussianRight, if_neg hj]
    have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    exact mul_nonneg (eulerC_pos hpR).le (by positivity)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianCentered_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianCentered_eq {p a : ℕ} {j : ℤ} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hj : j.natAbs ≤ a) :
    normalizedGaussianCentered p a j =
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j.natAbs * j.natAbs) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j.natAbs))⁻¹ *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j.natAbs))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact normalizedGaussianRight_eq hp hj

statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianCentered_tendsto {p : ℕ} {j : ℤ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ normalizedGaussianCentered p a j) atTop
      (nhds (eulerC (p : ℝ) *
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j.natAbs * j.natAbs)))
proof:
:= by
  exact normalizedGaussianRight_tendsto hp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedGaussianCentered_le_eulerC
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianCentered_le_eulerC {p a : ℕ} {j : ℤ}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    normalizedGaussianCentered p a j ≤
      eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j.natAbs * j.natAbs)
proof:
:= by
