name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.evenGaussianSummand_tendsto
statement:
theorem evenGaussianSummand_tendsto {p j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ evenGaussianSummand p a j) atTop
      (nhds (evenGaussianLimitSummand p j))
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_const_nhds.mul (normalizedGaussianRight_tendsto hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.summable_nat_gaussian_inv_pow
statement:
theorem summable_nat_gaussian_inv_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j))
proof:
:= by
  have hpR0 : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
  have hpR1 : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p))
  have hgeom : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one hpR0 hpR1
  exact hgeom.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j ↦ pow_nonneg hpR0 _)
    (fun j ↦ pow_le_pow_of_le_one hpR0 hpR1.le (Nat.le_mul_self j))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.exp_neg_log_sq_nat_eq_inv_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < p)
  rw [show -Real.log (p : ℝ) * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 =
      (j * j : ℕ) * (-Real.log (p : ℝ)) by norm_num; ring]
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hpR]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tsum_evenGaussianSummand_eq_normalized_total
statement:
theorem tsum_evenGaussianSummand_eq_normalized_total {p a : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∑' j : ℕ, evenGaussianSummand p a j =
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (a + 1))]
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have htail : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, evenGaussianSummand p a (j + 1)) =
        2 * ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, (qBinom p (2 * a) (a + (j + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, evenGaussianSummand p a (j + 1)) =
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, 2 *
              ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
                (qBinom p (2 * a) (a + (j + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          have hjlt : j < a := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
          have hja : j + 1 ≤ a := by omega
          simp [evenGaussianSummand, centerMultiplicity, normalizedGaussianRight, hja]
        _ = 2 * ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, (qBinom p (2 * a) (a + (j + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [htail]
    simp [evenGaussianSummand, centerMultiplicity, normalizedGaussianRight]
    rw [totalQBinom_even_split hp]
    push_cast
    ring
  · intro j hj
    have hja : a < j := by
      rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hj
      omega
    simp [evenGaussianSummand, normalizedGaussianRight, show ¬j ≤ a by omega]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tsum_evenGaussianLimitSummand_eq_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem tsum_evenGaussianLimitSummand_eq_sharpConstant {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∑' j : ℕ, evenGaussianLimitSummand p j = sharpConstant (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ evenGaussianLimitSummand p j) := by
    have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    refine ((summable_nat_gaussian_inv_pow hp).mul_left
      (2 * eulerC (p : ℝ))).of_nonneg_of_le ?_ ?_
    · intro j
      unfold evenGaussianLimitSummand centerMultiplicity
      split_ifs <;> positivity [eulerC_pos hpR]
    · intro j
      have hx : 0 ≤ eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) :=
        mul_nonneg (eulerC_pos hpR).le (by positivity)
      unfold evenGaussianLimitSummand centerMultiplicity
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hj, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
        linarith
      · rw [if_neg hj]
        change (2 : ℝ) * (eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)) ≤
            2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)
        ring_nf
        exact le_rfl
  rw [hsum.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  have htheta : gaussianTheta (p : ℝ) =
      1 + 2 * ∑' j : ℕ, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ ((j + 1) * (j + 1)) := by
    rw [gaussianTheta_eq_one_add_two_mul_tsum_pnat
      (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p)),
      tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ
        (f := fun n : ℕ ↦ Real.exp (-Real.log (p : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2))]
    congr 2
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    simpa using exp_neg_log_sq_nat_eq_inv_pow (p := p) (j := j + 1) (by omega)
  rw [sharpConstant, htheta]
  simp only [evenGaussianLimitSummand, centerMultiplicity, if_pos, Nat.cast_one,
    one_mul, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left]
  simp
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussian_even_rank_asymptotic
statement:
theorem gaussian_even_rank_asymptotic {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (sharpConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_evenGaussianLimitSummand_eq_sharpConstant hp]
  have hbound : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦
      2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)) :=
    (summable_nat_gaussian_inv_pow hp).mul_left _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ ∑' j : ℕ, evenGaussianSummand p a j) atTop
      (nhds (∑' j : ℕ, evenGaussianLimitSummand p j)) :=
    tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence
      (f := fun a j ↦ evenGaussianSummand p a j)
      (g := fun j ↦ evenGaussianLimitSummand p j)
      (bound := fun j ↦ 2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j))
      hbound (fun j ↦ evenGaussianSummand_tendsto hp)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a j ↦ by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
        · calc
            evenGaussianSummand p a j ≤
                2 * normalizedGaussianRight p a j := by
              have hn := normalizedGaussianRight_nonneg (p := p) (a := a) (j := j) hp
              unfold evenGaussianSummand centerMultiplicity
              by_cases hj : j = 0
              · simp only [if_pos hj, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
                linarith
              · rw [if_neg hj]
                change (2 : ℝ) * normalizedGaussianRight p a j ≤
                    2 * normalizedGaussianRight p a j
                exact le_rfl
            _ ≤ 2 * (eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)) := by
              gcongr
              exact normalizedGaussianRight_le hp
            _ = 2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := by ring
        · exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (normalizedGaussianRight_nonneg hp))
  exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a ↦
    tsum_evenGaussianSummand_eq_normalized_total hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedOddGaussianRight_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedOddGaussianRight_eq {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hj : j ≤ a) :
    normalizedOddGaussianRight p a j =
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a + 1) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedOddGaussianRight, if_pos hj,
    qBinom_cast_real_eq_gammaR hp (by omega : a + 1 + j ≤ 2 * a + 1)]
  have hsub : 2 * a + 1 - (a + 1 + j) = a - j := by omega
  rw [hsub]
  have hexp : a * (a + 1) = j * (j + 1) + (a + 1 + j) * (a - j) := by
    have := Nat.sub_add_cancel hj
    nlinarith
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
  have hscale : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
      (p : ℝ) ^ ((a + 1 + j) * (a - j)) =
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) := by
    rw [hexp, pow_add]
    simp [inv_pow, hp0]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
  calc
    (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
          ((p : ℝ) ^ ((a + 1 + j) * (a - j)) *
            gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a + 1) *
              ((gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ *
                (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹)) =
        ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
          (p : ℝ) ^ ((a + 1 + j) * (a - j))) *
            gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a + 1) *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ *
                (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a + 1) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by rw [hscale]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tendsto_double_add_one_nat_atTop
statement:
private theorem tendsto_double_add_one_nat_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ 2 * a + 1) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_atTop]
  intro b
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop b] with a ha
  omega

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedOddGaussianRight_tendsto
statement:
theorem normalizedOddGaussianRight_tendsto {p j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ normalizedOddGaussianRight p a j) atTop
      (nhds (eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have htwo := (gammaR_tendsto hpR).comp tendsto_double_add_one_nat_atTop
  have hplus₀ := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat (1 + j))
  have hplus : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹)
      atTop (nhds (eulerC (p : ℝ))) := by
    change Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + (1 + j)))⁻¹)
      atTop (nhds (eulerC (p : ℝ))) at hplus₀
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hplus₀
  have hminus := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR).comp (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat j)
  have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1))) atTop
      (nhds ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)))) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have hprod := ((hc.mul htwo).mul hplus).mul hminus
  have htend : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ normalizedOddGaussianRight p a j) atTop
      (nhds ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * (eulerC (p : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        eulerC (p : ℝ) * eulerC (p : ℝ))) := by
    apply hprod.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop j] with a ha
    rw [normalizedOddGaussianRight_eq hp ha]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  have hC0 : eulerC (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (eulerC_pos hpR)
  convert htend using 1
  field_simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedOddGaussianRight_nonneg
statement:
theorem normalizedOddGaussianRight_nonneg {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ normalizedOddGaussianRight p a j
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedOddGaussianRight
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · exact le_rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normalizedOddGaussianRight_le
statement:
theorem normalizedOddGaussianRight_le {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    normalizedOddGaussianRight p a j ≤
      eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j ≤ a
  · rw [normalizedOddGaussianRight_eq hp hj]
    have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p)
    have hpow : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) :=
      pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith)) _
    have hgam : 0 ≤ gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a + 1) := (gammaR_pos hp1 _).le
    have hplus : 0 ≤ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ :=
      (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 _)).le
    have hminus : 0 ≤ (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ :=
      (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 _)).le
    calc
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * gammaR (p : ℝ) (2 * a + 1) *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ ≤
          (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * 1 *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + 1 + j))⁻¹ *
              (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_le_one hp1 _) hpow) hplus) hminus
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * 1 * eulerC (p : ℝ) *
            (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR _).le
            (mul_nonneg hpow zero_le_one)) hminus
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) * 1 * eulerC (p : ℝ) *
            eulerC (p : ℝ) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR _).le
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hpow zero_le_one) (eulerC_pos hpR).le)
      _ = eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) := by ring
  · rw [normalizedOddGaussianRight, if_neg hj]
    exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)) _)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.oddGaussianSummand_tendsto
statement:
theorem oddGaussianSummand_tendsto {p j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ oddGaussianSummand p a j) atTop
      (nhds (oddGaussianLimitSummand p j))
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_const_nhds.mul (normalizedOddGaussianRight_tendsto hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.summable_nat_odd_gaussian_inv_pow
statement:
theorem summable_nat_odd_gaussian_inv_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpR0 : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
  have hpR1 : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 :=
    inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p))
  have hgeom : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one hpR0 hpR1
  exact hgeom.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j ↦ pow_nonneg hpR0 _)
    (fun j ↦ pow_le_pow_of_le_one hpR0 hpR1.le (by
      calc
        j = j * 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ j * (j + 1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left j (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le j))))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.totalQBinom_odd_split
statement:
theorem totalQBinom_odd_split {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (a : ℕ) :
    totalQBinom q (2 * a + 1) =
      2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), qBinom q (2 * a + 1) (a + 1 + j)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun k ↦ qBinom q (2 * a + 1) k
  have hlow : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), f j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), f (a + 1 + j) := by
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), f j) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), f (a + 1 - 1 - j) :=
        (Finset.sum_range_reflect f (a + 1)).symm
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), f (a + 1 + j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hja : j < a + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        dsimp [f]
        rw [qBinom_symm hq (by omega : a - j ≤ 2 * a + 1)]
        congr 1
        omega
  rw [totalQBinom, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  have hsize : 2 * a + 1 + 1 = (a + 1) + (a + 1) := by omega
  rw [hsize, Finset.sum_range_add, hlow]
  dsimp [f]
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tsum_oddGaussianSummand_eq_normalized_total
statement:
theorem tsum_oddGaussianSummand_eq_normalized_total {p a : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∑' j : ℕ, oddGaussianSummand p a j =
      quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
        (totalQBinom p (2 * a + 1) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (a + 1))]
  · calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), oddGaussianSummand p a j) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1),
            2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
              (qBinom p (2 * a + 1) (a + 1 + j) : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hjlt : j < a + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        have hja : j ≤ a := by omega
        simp [oddGaussianSummand, normalizedOddGaussianRight, hja]
        ring
      _ = 2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1),
              (qBinom p (2 * a + 1) (a + 1 + j) : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
            (totalQBinom p (2 * a + 1) : ℝ) := by
        rw [totalQBinom_odd_split hp]
        push_cast
        ring
  · intro j hj
    have hja : a < j := by
      rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hj
      omega
    simp [oddGaussianSummand, normalizedOddGaussianRight, show ¬j ≤ a by omega]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.exp_neg_log_nat_eq_inv_pow
statement:
private theorem exp_neg_log_nat_eq_inv_pow {p m : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Real.exp (-Real.log (p : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < p)
  rw [show -Real.log (p : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) =
      (m : ℕ) * (-Real.log (p : ℝ)) by norm_num; ring]
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hpR]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shiftedTheta_half_eq_quarterShiftScale_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem shiftedTheta_half_eq_quarterShiftScale_mul_tsum {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    shiftedTheta (p : ℝ) (1 / 2) = quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) *
      (2 * ∑' j : ℕ, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℤ → ℝ := fun z ↦
    Real.exp (-Real.log (p : ℝ) * ((z : ℝ) - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2)
  let e : ℤ ≃ ℕ ⊕ ℕ := (Equiv.neg ℤ).trans Equiv.intEquivNatSumNat
  have hF : Summable F := by
    simpa only [F] using shiftedTheta_summable
      (p := (p : ℝ)) (x := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p))
  have hleft : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ F (e.symm (Sum.inl j))) := by
    change Summable (F ∘ (fun j : ℕ ↦ e.symm (Sum.inl j)))
    exact hF.comp_injective (e.symm.injective.comp Sum.inl_injective)
  have hright : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦ F (e.symm (Sum.inr j))) := by
    change Summable (F ∘ (fun j : ℕ ↦ e.symm (Sum.inr j)))
    exact hF.comp_injective (e.symm.injective.comp Sum.inr_injective)
  have hsplit :
      (∑' s : ℕ ⊕ ℕ, F (e.symm s)) =
        (∑' j : ℕ, F (e.symm (Sum.inl j))) +
          ∑' j : ℕ, F (e.symm (Sum.inr j)) :=
    (hleft.hasSum.sum hright.hasSum).tsum_eq
  have hleftterm (j : ℕ) :
      F (e.symm (Sum.inl j)) =
        quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) := by
    have he : e.symm (Sum.inl j) = -(j : ℤ) := rfl
    rw [he]
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [← exp_neg_log_nat_eq_inv_pow (p := p) (m := j * (j + 1)) (by omega)]
    rw [quarterShiftScale, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    norm_num
    ring
  have hrightterm (j : ℕ) :
      F (e.symm (Sum.inr j)) =
        quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) := by
    have he : e.symm (Sum.inr j) = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := rfl
    rw [he]
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [← exp_neg_log_nat_eq_inv_pow (p := p) (m := j * (j + 1)) (by omega)]
    rw [quarterShiftScale, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    norm_num
    ring
  unfold shiftedTheta
  change (∑' z : ℤ, F z) = _
  rw [← e.symm.tsum_eq F, hsplit]
  simp_rw [hleftterm, hrightterm]
  rw [tsum_mul_left]
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tsum_oddGaussianLimitSummand_eq_oddGaussianConstant
statement:
theorem tsum_oddGaussianLimitSummand_eq_oddGaussianConstant {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∑' j : ℕ, oddGaussianLimitSummand p j = oddGaussianConstant (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have htheta := shiftedTheta_half_eq_quarterShiftScale_mul_tsum hp
  unfold oddGaussianLimitSummand oddGaussianConstant
  calc
    (∑' j : ℕ, 2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) *
        (eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)))) =
        (2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * eulerC (p : ℝ)) *
          ∑' j : ℕ, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) := by
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro j
      ring
    _ = eulerC (p : ℝ) *
        (quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) *
          (2 * ∑' j : ℕ, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)))) := by ring
    _ = eulerC (p : ℝ) * shiftedTheta (p : ℝ) (1 / 2) := by rw [htheta]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.oddGaussianSummand_nonneg
statement:
theorem oddGaussianSummand_nonneg {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ oddGaussianSummand p a j
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : 0 ≤ quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hscale)
    (normalizedOddGaussianRight_nonneg hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.oddGaussianSummand_le
statement:
theorem oddGaussianSummand_le {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    oddGaussianSummand p a j ≤
      2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold oddGaussianSummand
  have hs : 0 ≤ 2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc
    2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * normalizedOddGaussianRight p a j ≤
        2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) *
          (eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (normalizedOddGaussianRight_le hp) hs
    _ = 2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1)) := by ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussian_odd_rank_asymptotic
statement:
theorem gaussian_odd_rank_asymptotic {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) *
        (totalQBinom p (2 * a + 1) : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (oddGaussianConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_oddGaussianLimitSummand_eq_oddGaussianConstant hp]
  have hbound : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦
      2 * quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * eulerC (p : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * (j + 1))) :=
    (summable_nat_odd_gaussian_inv_pow hp).mul_left _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ ∑' j : ℕ, oddGaussianSummand p a j)
      atTop (nhds (∑' j : ℕ, oddGaussianLimitSummand p j)) :=
    tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hbound
      (fun j : ℕ ↦ oddGaussianSummand_tendsto hp)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (a j : ℕ) ↦ ?_)
  · convert ht using 1
    funext a
    exact (tsum_oddGaussianSummand_eq_normalized_total (a := a) hp).symm
  · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (oddGaussianSummand_nonneg hp)]
    exact oddGaussianSummand_le hp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.quarterShiftScale_mul_centered_power
statement:
theorem quarterShiftScale_mul_centered_power {p a : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) =
      Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (-(((2 * a + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / 4))
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < p)
  change quarterShiftScale (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1)) =
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-(((2 * a + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / 4))
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hpR]
  rw [← exp_neg_log_nat_eq_inv_pow (p := p) (m := a * (a + 1)) (by omega),
    quarterShiftScale, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussian_odd_rank_rpow_asymptotic
statement:
theorem gaussian_odd_rank_rpow_asymptotic {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (-(((2 * a + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / 4)) *
        (totalQBinom p (2 * a + 1) : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (oddGaussianConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply (gaussian_odd_rank_asymptotic hp).congr'
  filter_upwards with a
  rw [quarterShiftScale_mul_centered_power hp]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.oddGaussianConstant_lt_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem oddGaussianConstant_lt_sharpConstant {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    oddGaussianConstant p < sharpConstant p
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : ¬ ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hz' : (2 : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) = 1 := by rw [hz]; norm_num
    have hzInt : (2 : ℤ) * z = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hz'
    omega
  have htheta := shiftedTheta_lt_of_not_integer (p := p) (x := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (by linarith) hhalf
  simpa [oddGaussianConstant, sharpConstant] using
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left htheta (eulerC_pos hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.centered_power_normalization
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : a * a = j * j + (a + j) * (a - j) := by
    have := Nat.sub_add_cancel hj
    nlinarith
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
  rw [hexp, pow_add]
  simp [inv_pow, hp0]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.tsum_evenUSummand_eq_normalized_U
statement:
theorem tsum_evenUSummand_eq_normalized_U {p a : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∑' j : ℕ, evenUSummand p a j =
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * primePowerU p (2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun r ↦
    (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
      ((p : ℝ) ^ (r * (2 * a - r)) * (gammaR (p : ℝ) r)⁻¹)
  have hhigh (j : ℕ) (hj : j < a) :
      f (a + (j + 1)) = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ ((j + 1) * (j + 1)) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + (j + 1)))⁻¹ := by
    have hja : j + 1 ≤ a := by omega
    dsimp [f]
    have hsub : 2 * a - (a + (j + 1)) = a - (j + 1) := by omega
    rw [hsub, ← mul_assoc, centered_power_normalization (by omega) hja]
  have hlow (j : ℕ) (hj : j < a) :
      f (a - 1 - j) = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ ((j + 1) * (j + 1)) *
        (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - (j + 1)))⁻¹ := by
    have hja : j + 1 ≤ a := by omega
    have hindex : a - 1 - j = a - (j + 1) := by omega
    have hsub : 2 * a - (a - (j + 1)) = a + (j + 1) := by omega
    dsimp [f]
    rw [hindex, hsub]
    have hcenter := centered_power_normalization (p := p) (a := a) (j := j + 1)
      (by omega) hja
    rw [mul_comm (a - (j + 1)) (a + (j + 1)), ← mul_assoc, hcenter]
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (a + 1))]
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
    have hcenter : f a = (gammaR (p : ℝ) a)⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [f]
      have hsub : 2 * a - a = a := by omega
      rw [hsub]
      simp [inv_pow, hp0]
    have hpairs : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, evenUSummand p a (j + 1)) =
        (∑ r ∈ Finset.range a, f r) +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + 1 + j) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect f a, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have hja : j < a := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      have hind : a + 1 + j = a + (j + 1) := by omega
      rw [hind, hhigh j hja, hlow j hja]
      simp [evenUSummand, show j + 1 ≤ a by omega]
      ring
    rw [hpairs]
    simp only [evenUSummand, if_pos]
    rw [← hcenter]
    have hU : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * primePowerU p (2 * a) =
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (2 * a + 1), f r := by
      rw [primePowerU]
      have hfin := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun r : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ) ^ (r * (2 * a - r)) *
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) r)⁻¹) (2 * a + 1)
      rw [hfin, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hU]
    have hsize : 2 * a + 1 = (a + 1) + a := by omega
    rw [hsize, Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring
  · intro j hj
    have hja : a < j := by
      rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hj
      omega
    simp [evenUSummand, show j ≠ 0 by omega, show ¬j ≤ a by omega]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.evenUSummand_tendsto
statement:
theorem evenUSummand_tendsto {p j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ evenUSummand p a j) atTop
      (nhds (evenGaussianLimitSummand p j))
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simpa [evenUSummand, evenGaussianLimitSummand, centerMultiplicity] using
      gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR
  · have hplus := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat j)
    have hminus := (gammaR_inv_tendsto hpR).comp (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat j)
    have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)) atTop
        (nhds ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j))) := tendsto_const_nhds
    have ht := hc.mul (hplus.add hminus)
    have hlim : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) *
        (eulerC (p : ℝ) + eulerC (p : ℝ)) =
          evenGaussianLimitSummand p j := by
      simp only [evenGaussianLimitSummand, centerMultiplicity, if_neg hj0,
        Nat.cast_ofNat]
      ring
    rw [← hlim]
    apply ht.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop j] with a ha
    simp [evenUSummand, hj0, ha]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.evenUSummand_nonneg
statement:
theorem evenUSummand_nonneg {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ evenUSummand p a j
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p)
  unfold evenUSummand
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · rw [if_pos hj0]
    exact (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 a)).le
  · rw [if_neg hj0]
    by_cases hja : j ≤ a
    · rw [if_pos hja]
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity)
        (add_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 (a + j))).le
          (inv_pos.mpr (gammaR_pos hp1 (a - j))).le)
    · rw [if_neg hja]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.evenUSummand_le
statement:
theorem evenUSummand_le {p a j : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    evenUSummand p a j ≤
      2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  unfold evenUSummand
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp only [if_pos, Nat.zero_mul, pow_zero, mul_one]
    linarith [gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR a, eulerC_pos hpR]
  · rw [if_neg hj0]
    by_cases hja : j ≤ a
    · rw [if_pos hja]
      have hpow : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j) := by positivity
      have hsum : (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a + j))⁻¹ +
          (gammaR (p : ℝ) (a - j))⁻¹ ≤ 2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) := by
        linarith [gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR (a + j),
          gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hpR (a - j)]
      nlinarith
    · rw [if_neg hja]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (eulerC_pos hpR).le) (by positivity)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.primePowerU_even_rank_asymptotic
statement:
theorem primePowerU_even_rank_asymptotic {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * primePowerU p (2 * a)) atTop
      (nhds (sharpConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_evenGaussianLimitSummand_eq_sharpConstant hp]
  have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hbound : Summable (fun j : ℕ ↦
      2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j)) :=
    (summable_nat_gaussian_inv_pow hp).mul_left _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ ∑' j : ℕ, evenUSummand p a j) atTop
      (nhds (∑' j : ℕ, evenGaussianLimitSummand p j)) :=
    tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence
      (f := fun a j ↦ evenUSummand p a j)
      (g := fun j ↦ evenGaussianLimitSummand p j)
      (bound := fun j ↦ 2 * eulerC (p : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j * j))
      hbound (fun j ↦ evenUSummand_tendsto hp)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a j ↦ by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (evenUSummand_nonneg hp)]
        exact evenUSummand_le hp)
  exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a ↦
    tsum_evenUSummand_eq_normalized_U hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussian_total_div_primePowerU_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem gaussian_total_div_primePowerU_tendsto_one {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ) / primePowerU p (2 * a)) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv := (gaussian_even_rank_asymptotic hp).div
    (primePowerU_even_rank_asymptotic hp)
    (ne_of_gt (sharpConstant_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp)))
  have hCne : sharpConstant (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (sharpConstant_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp))
  rw [div_self hCne] at hdiv
  apply hdiv.congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a ↦ by
    have hp0 : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) ≠ 0 := by
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)))
    dsimp
    field_simp [hp0]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementaryAbelian_subspace_escape_equality
statement:
theorem elementaryAbelian_subspace_escape_equality (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin (2 * a) → ZMod p)) = totalQBinom p (2 * a)
proof:
:=
  card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod p (2 * a)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.sharpConstant_le_of_even_rank_bound
statement:
theorem sharpConstant_le_of_even_rank_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ a : ℕ,
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    sharpConstant (p : ℝ) ≤ C
proof:
:=
  le_of_tendsto (gaussian_even_rank_asymptotic hp) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.no_vanishing_normalized_bound
statement:
theorem no_vanishing_normalized_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : Tendsto b atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbound : ∀ a : ℕ,
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ) ≤ b a) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hle : sharpConstant (p : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (gaussian_even_rank_asymptotic hp) hb
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)
  exact (not_le_of_gt (sharpConstant_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp))) hle

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.no_subquarter_normalized_exponential_bound
statement:
theorem no_subquarter_normalized_exponential_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    {α C : ℝ} (hα : α < 1 / 4) :
    ¬ ∀ a : ℕ,
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ) ≤
        C * Real.exp
          (Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbound
  apply no_vanishing_normalized_bound hp
    (fun a : ℕ ↦ C * Real.exp
      (Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) * (a : ℝ) ^ 2))
  · have hcast : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ (a : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have hsq : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦ (a : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop atTop := by
      simpa [pow_two] using hcast.atTop_mul_atTop₀ hcast
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p))
    have hcoef : Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) < 0 := by
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hlog (by linarith)
    have hexponent : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
        Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) * (a : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop atBot := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hsq.const_mul_atTop_of_neg hcoef
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ C) atTop (nhds C) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using
      hconst.mul (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp hexponent)
  · exact hbound

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.no_subquarter_rpow_bound
statement:
theorem no_subquarter_rpow_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {α C : ℝ}
    (hα : α < 1 / 4) :
    ¬ ∀ a : ℕ,
      (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ) ≤
        C * Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (4 * α * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbound
  apply no_subquarter_normalized_exponential_bound hp hα
  intro a
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < p)
  calc
    (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) * (totalQBinom p (2 * a) : ℝ) ≤
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
          (C * Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (4 * α * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound a) (by positivity)
    _ = C * Real.exp
          (Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) * (a : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      change (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
          (C * (p : ℝ) ^ (4 * α * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)) =
        C * Real.exp
          (Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hpR]
      rw [← exp_neg_log_nat_eq_inv_pow (p := p) (m := a * a) (by omega)]
      calc
        Real.exp (-Real.log (p : ℝ) * ((a * a : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
              (C * Real.exp (Real.log (p : ℝ) *
                (4 * α * (a : ℝ) ^ 2))) =
            C * (Real.exp (-Real.log (p : ℝ) * ((a * a : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
              Real.exp (Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α * (a : ℝ) ^ 2))) := by ring
        _ = C * Real.exp
            ((-Real.log (p : ℝ) * ((a * a : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
              Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add]
        _ = C * Real.exp
            (Real.log (p : ℝ) * (4 * α - 1) * (a : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
          congr 2
          push_cast
          ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.isCoatom_of_prime_index
statement: theorem isCoatom_of_prime_index (H : Subgroup G) (hprime : H.index.Prime) : IsCoatom H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro htop
    exact hprime.ne_one (by simp [htop])
  · intro K hHK
    have hdvd : K.index ∣ H.index := H.index_dvd_of_le hHK.le
    rcases hprime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd K.index hdvd with hK | hK
    · exact Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp hK
    · have htower := H.relIndex_mul_index hHK.le
      have hrel : H.relIndex K = 1 := by
        apply Nat.mul_right_cancel
          (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite (H := H)))
        simpa [hK] using htower
      exact ((not_le_of_gt hHK) (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp hrel)).elim

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normal_of_index_eq_prime_of_isPGroup
statement:
theorem normal_of_index_eq_prime_of_isPGroup {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hG : IsPGroup p G) (H : Subgroup G) (hindex : H.index = p) : H.Normal
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hcard⟩ := hG.exists_card_eq
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.card_pos H.index_dvd_card
    rw [hindex, hcard, hc, pow_zero] at hle
    have := hp.one_lt
    omega
  apply H.normal_of_index_eq_minFac_card
  rw [hindex, hcard, hp.pow_minFac hc]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.coatomFiber_card_le_relIndex
statement:
theorem coatomFiber_card_le_relIndex (M V : Subgroup G) [M.Normal]
    (hM : IsCoatom M) (hVM : V ≤ M) :
    Fintype.card (CoatomFiber M V) ≤ V.relIndex M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, -, hxM⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hM.lt_top
  have sup_eq_top (S : Subgroup G) (hS : ¬ S ≤ M) : S ⊔ M = ⊤ := by
    apply (hM.ne_iff_eq_top le_sup_right).mp
    intro hSM
    exact hS (le_sup_left.trans_eq hSM)
  have exists_rep (Q : CoatomFiber M V) : ∃ m : M, x * (m : G) ∈ Q.1 := by
    have hxQM : x ∈ Q.1 ⊔ M := by
      rw [sup_eq_top Q.1 Q.2.2]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top x
    obtain ⟨q, hq, m, hm, hqmx⟩ :=
      (Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_right (s := Q.1) (t := M) (x := x)).mp hxQM
    refine ⟨⟨m⁻¹, M.inv_mem hm⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hqmx]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hq
  let rep : CoatomFiber M V → M := fun Q ↦ Classical.choose (exists_rep Q)
  have rep_mem (Q : CoatomFiber M V) : x * (rep Q : G) ∈ Q.1 :=
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_rep Q)
  have hVQ (Q : CoatomFiber M V) : V ≤ Q.1 := by
    intro v hv
    have hvInf : v ∈ Q.1 ⊓ M := by
      rw [Q.2.1]
      exact hv
    exact hvInf.1
  have generated (Q : CoatomFiber M V) :
      V ⊔ Subgroup.closure {x * (rep Q : G)} = Q.1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine sup_le (hVQ Q) ((Subgroup.closure_le Q.1).2 ?_)
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy]
      exact rep_mem Q
    · let R : Subgroup G := V ⊔ Subgroup.closure {x * (rep Q : G)}
      have hRQ : R ≤ Q.1 := by
        refine sup_le (hVQ Q) ((Subgroup.closure_le Q.1).2 ?_)
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy]
        exact rep_mem Q
      have hqR : x * (rep Q : G) ∈ R :=
        Subgroup.mem_sup_right (Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _))
      have hqM : x * (rep Q : G) ∉ M := by
        intro h
        apply hxM
        have hmInv : (rep Q : G)⁻¹ ∈ M := M.inv_mem (rep Q).2
        simpa [mul_assoc] using M.mul_mem h hmInv
      have hRnot : ¬ R ≤ M := fun h ↦ hqM (h hqR)
      have hRM : R ⊔ M = ⊤ := sup_eq_top R hRnot
      intro y hy
      have hyRM : y ∈ R ⊔ M := by
        rw [hRM]
        exact Subgroup.mem_top y
      obtain ⟨r, hr, m, hm, hrmy⟩ :=
        (Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_right (s := R) (t := M) (x := y)).mp hyRM
      have hmQ : m ∈ Q.1 := by
        have hm_eq : m = r⁻¹ * y := by
          rw [← hrmy]
          simp
        rw [hm_eq]
        exact Q.1.mul_mem (Q.1.inv_mem (hRQ hr)) hy
      have hmV : m ∈ V := by
        rw [← Q.2.1]
        exact ⟨hmQ, hm⟩
      have hmR : m ∈ R := Subgroup.mem_sup_left hmV
      rw [← hrmy]
      exact R.mul_mem hr hmR
  let f : CoatomFiber M V → M ⧸ V.subgroupOf M := fun Q ↦ QuotientGroup.mk (rep Q)
  have fiber_le (A B : CoatomFiber M V) (hf : f A = f B) : B.1 ≤ A.1 := by
    rw [← generated B]
    refine sup_le (hVQ A) ((Subgroup.closure_le A.1).2 ?_)
    rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    have hvM : (rep A)⁻¹ * rep B ∈ V.subgroupOf M := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hf
    have hv : (rep A : G)⁻¹ * (rep B : G) ∈ V := Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hvM
    have hvA : (rep A : G)⁻¹ * (rep B : G) ∈ A.1 := hVQ A hv
    have hprod := A.1.mul_mem (rep_mem A) hvA
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hprod
  have hf_injective : Function.Injective f := by
    intro A B hf
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact le_antisymm (fiber_le B A hf.symm) (fiber_le A B hf)
  calc
    Fintype.card (CoatomFiber M V) ≤ Fintype.card (M ⧸ V.subgroupOf M) :=
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf_injective
    _ = V.relIndex M := by
      rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
      rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.mem_primePowerLayer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primePowerLayer {p k : ℕ} {T P Q : Subgroup G} :
    Q ∈ primePowerLayer p k T P ↔ T ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ P ∧ Q.relIndex P = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [primePowerLayer]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.primePowerLayer_card_subgroup
statement:
theorem primePowerLayer_card_subgroup {p k : ℕ} {T P : Subgroup G} (hTP : T ≤ P) :
    (primePowerLayer p k T P).card =
      (primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let toSubgroup (Q : ↑(primePowerLayer p k T P)) :
      ↑(primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P)) := by
    refine ⟨Q.1.subgroupOf P, ?_⟩
    have hQ := (mem_primePowerLayer.mp Q.2)
    apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
    refine ⟨Subgroup.comap_mono hQ.1, le_top, ?_⟩
    simpa using
      (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := Q.1) (K := P) (L := P) le_rfl).trans hQ.2.2
  let fromSubgroup (R : ↑(primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P))) :
      ↑(primePowerLayer p k T P) := by
    refine ⟨R.1.map P.subtype, ?_⟩
    have hR := mem_primePowerLayer.mp R.2
    apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, Subgroup.map_subtype_le R.1, ?_⟩
    · calc
        T = Subgroup.map P.subtype (T.subgroupOf P) :=
          (Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le hTP).symm
        _ ≤ Subgroup.map P.subtype R.1 := Subgroup.map_mono hR.1
    · have hi := Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective R.1 (⊤ : Subgroup P)
          P.subtype_injective
      have htop : Subgroup.map P.subtype (⊤ : Subgroup P) = P := by
        rw [← P.subtype.range_eq_map, Subgroup.range_subtype]
      rw [htop] at hi
      exact hi.trans hR.2.2
  have hleft (Q : ↑(primePowerLayer p k T P)) : fromSubgroup (toSubgroup Q) = Q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le (mem_primePowerLayer.mp Q.2).2.1
  have hright (R : ↑(primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P))) :
      toSubgroup (fromSubgroup R) = R := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective P.subtype_injective R.1
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe, ← Fintype.card_coe]
  exact Fintype.card_congr
    { toFun := toSubgroup
      invFun := fromSubgroup
      left_inv := hleft
      right_inv := hright }

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.pGroup_primePowerLayer_card_le
statement:
theorem pGroup_primePowerLayer_card_le {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hG : IsPGroup p G)
    (T : Subgroup G) (hindex : T.index = p ^ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (primePowerLayer p k T ⊤).card ≤ qBinom p a k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  induction a generalizing G T k with
  | zero =>
      have hT : T = ⊤ := Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp (by simpa using hindex)
      subst T
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have hlayer : primePowerLayer p 0 (⊤ : Subgroup G) ⊤ = {⊤} := by
            ext Q
            constructor
            · intro hQ
              have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQ
              exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr
                (top_unique (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp (by simpa using hQl.2.2)))
            · intro hQ
              have hQtop := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hQ
              subst Q
              exact mem_primePowerLayer.mpr ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, by simp⟩
          simp [hlayer]
      | succ k =>
          have hpow : p ^ (k + 1) ≠ 1 := by
            exact (Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) hp.one_lt).ne'
          simp [primePowerLayer, hpow, hpow.symm]
  | succ a ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have hlayer : primePowerLayer p 0 T ⊤ = {⊤} := by
            ext Q
            constructor
            · intro hQ
              have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQ
              exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr
                (top_unique (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp (by simpa using hQl.2.2)))
            · intro hQ
              have hQtop := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hQ
              subst Q
              exact mem_primePowerLayer.mpr ⟨le_top, le_rfl, by simp⟩
          simp [hlayer]
      | succ k =>
          obtain ⟨b, hTcard⟩ := (hG.to_subgroup T).exists_card_eq
          have hcardG : Nat.card G = p ^ (b + (a + 1)) := by
            rw [← T.card_mul_index, hTcard, hindex, ← pow_add]
          have hdvd : p ^ (b + a) ∣ Nat.card G := by
            rw [hcardG, show b + (a + 1) = (b + a) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
            exact dvd_mul_right _ _
          obtain ⟨M, hMcard, hTM⟩ :=
            Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime_le (G := G) p hdvd T hTcard (by omega)
          have hMindex : M.index = p := by
            apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (pow_pos hp.pos _)
            calc
              p ^ (b + a) * M.index = Nat.card G := by
                rw [← hMcard]
                exact M.card_mul_index
              _ = p ^ (b + a) * p := by
                rw [hcardG, show b + (a + 1) = (b + a) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
          letI : M.Normal := normal_of_index_eq_prime_of_isPGroup hp hG M hMindex
          have hMcoatom : IsCoatom M := isCoatom_of_prime_index M (hMindex.symm ▸ hp)
          have hTrelM : T.relIndex M = p ^ a := by
            have htower := T.relIndex_mul_index hTM
            apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hp.pos
            simpa [hMindex, hindex, pow_succ] using htower
          let layer := primePowerLayer p (k + 1) T ⊤
          let inside := layer.filter fun Q ↦ Q ≤ M
          let outside := layer.filter fun Q ↦ ¬Q ≤ M
          have hsplit : inside.card + outside.card = layer.card := by
            exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := layer) (fun Q ↦ Q ≤ M)
          let lowerLayer := primePowerLayer p k T M
          have hins_maps : (inside : Set (Subgroup G)) ⊆ (lowerLayer : Set (Subgroup G)) := by
            intro Q hQ
            have hQi := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ
            have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQi.1
            apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
            refine ⟨hQl.1, hQi.2, ?_⟩
            have htower := Q.relIndex_mul_index hQi.2
            apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hp.pos
            calc
              Q.relIndex M * p = Q.index := by
                rw [← hMindex]
                exact htower
              _ = p ^ (k + 1) := by
                rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
                exact hQl.2.2
              _ = p ^ k * p := by rw [pow_succ]
          have hlower : lowerLayer.card ≤ qBinom p a k := by
            rw [primePowerLayer_card_subgroup hTM]
            exact ih (G := M) (hG.to_subgroup M) (T.subgroupOf M) (by
              simpa using
                (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := T) (K := M) (L := M) le_rfl).trans hTrelM) k
          have hinside : inside.card ≤ qBinom p a k :=
            (Finset.card_le_card hins_maps).trans hlower
          let upperLayer := primePowerLayer p (k + 1) T M
          have hout_maps : (outside : Set (Subgroup G)).MapsTo (fun Q ↦ Q ⊓ M) upperLayer := by
            intro Q hQ
            have hQo := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ
            have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQo.1
            have hsup : M ⊔ Q = ⊤ := by
              apply hMcoatom.2
              refine lt_of_le_of_ne le_sup_left ?_
              intro heq
              exact hQo.2 (le_sup_right.trans_eq heq.symm)
            have hVrelQ : (Q ⊓ M).relIndex Q = p := by
              calc
                (Q ⊓ M).relIndex Q = M.relIndex Q := by
                  simpa [inf_comm] using M.inf_relIndex_right Q
                _ = M.relIndex (M ⊔ Q) := (Q.relIndex_sup_left M).symm
                _ = p := by rw [hsup, Subgroup.relIndex_top_right, hMindex]
            have hVrelM : (Q ⊓ M).relIndex M = p ^ (k + 1) := by
              have htowerM := (Q ⊓ M).relIndex_mul_index inf_le_right
              have htowerQ := (Q ⊓ M).relIndex_mul_index inf_le_left
              have hQindex : Q.index = p ^ (k + 1) := by
                rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
                exact hQl.2.2
              apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hp.pos
              calc
                (Q ⊓ M).relIndex M * p = (Q ⊓ M).index := by
                  simpa [hMindex] using htowerM
                _ = (Q ⊓ M).relIndex Q * Q.index := htowerQ.symm
                _ = p * p ^ (k + 1) := by rw [hVrelQ, hQindex]
                _ = p ^ (k + 1) * p := by ac_rfl
            apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
            exact ⟨le_inf hQl.1 hTM, inf_le_right, hVrelM⟩
          have houtside : outside.card ≤ p ^ (k + 1) * qBinom p a (k + 1) := by
            rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hout_maps]
            calc
              ∑ V ∈ upperLayer, (outside.filter fun Q ↦ Q ⊓ M = V).card ≤
                  ∑ _V ∈ upperLayer, p ^ (k + 1) := by
                    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                    intro V hV
                    let actualFiber := outside.filter fun Q ↦ Q ⊓ M = V
                    let embed (Q : ↑actualFiber) : CoatomFiber M V := by
                      have hQf := Finset.mem_filter.mp Q.2
                      have hQo := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQf.1
                      exact ⟨Q.1, hQf.2, hQo.2⟩
                    have hembed : Function.Injective embed := by
                      intro Q R hQR
                      apply Subtype.ext
                      exact congrArg (fun X : CoatomFiber M V ↦ X.1) hQR
                    have hactual : actualFiber.card ≤ Fintype.card (CoatomFiber M V) := by
                      rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
                      exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective embed hembed
                    have hVmem := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hV
                    exact hactual.trans
                      ((coatomFiber_card_le_relIndex M V hMcoatom hVmem.2.1).trans_eq
                        hVmem.2.2)
              _ = upperLayer.card * p ^ (k + 1) :=
                    Finset.sum_const_nat fun _ _ ↦ rfl
              _ ≤ qBinom p a (k + 1) * p ^ (k + 1) := by
                    gcongr
                    rw [primePowerLayer_card_subgroup hTM]
                    exact ih (G := M) (hG.to_subgroup M) (T.subgroupOf M) (by
                      simpa using
                        (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := T) (K := M) (L := M)
                          le_rfl).trans hTrelM) (k + 1)
              _ = p ^ (k + 1) * qBinom p a (k + 1) := by ac_rfl
          rw [← hsplit]
          calc
            inside.card + outside.card ≤
                qBinom p a k + p ^ (k + 1) * qBinom p a (k + 1) :=
              Nat.add_le_add hinside houtside
            _ = qBinom p (a + 1) (k + 1) := (qBinom_succ_succ p a k).symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.exists_sylow_pretransitive_of_index_primePower
statement:
theorem exists_sylow_pretransitive_of_index_primePower {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hindex : H.index = p ^ a) :
    ∃ P : Sylow p G,
      MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) ∧ H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = p ^ a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let S : Sylow p H := Sylow.nonempty.some
  obtain ⟨P, hPcomap⟩ := S.exists_comap_subtype_eq
  obtain ⟨b, hScard⟩ := S.2.exists_card_eq
  let e : H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G) ≃ S :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ by
        let y : H := ⟨(x.1 : G), x.2⟩
        refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
        rw [← hPcomap]
        exact x.1.2
      invFun := fun y ↦ by
        have hyP : (y.1 : G) ∈ (P : Subgroup G) := by
          have : y.1 ∈ P.comap H.subtype := by simpa [hPcomap] using y.2
          exact this
        exact ⟨⟨(y.1 : G), hyP⟩, y.1.2⟩
      left_inv := by intro x; ext; rfl
      right_inv := by intro y; ext; rfl }
  have hinterCard : Nat.card (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) = p ^ b := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr e, hScard]
  have hPcard_tower :
      Nat.card (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) * H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = Nat.card P := by
    exact (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)).card_mul_index
  have hrel_le : H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) ≤ H.index := by
    simpa using H.relIndex_le_of_le_right (K := (P : Subgroup G)) (L := ⊤) le_top
      Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite
  have hPcard_le : Nat.card P ≤ p ^ (b + a) := by
    rw [← hPcard_tower, hinterCard, pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hrel_le.trans_eq hindex)
  have hpow_dvd_cardG : p ^ (b + a) ∣ Nat.card G := by
    refine ⟨S.index, ?_⟩
    calc
      Nat.card G = Nat.card H * H.index := H.card_mul_index.symm
      _ = (Nat.card S * S.index) * p ^ a := by rw [hindex, S.card_mul_index]
      _ = p ^ (b + a) * S.index := by rw [hScard, pow_add]; ac_rfl
  have hpow_dvd_cardP : p ^ (b + a) ∣ Nat.card P :=
    P.pow_dvd_card_of_pow_dvd_card hpow_dvd_cardG
  have hPcard : Nat.card P = p ^ (b + a) := by
    apply le_antisymm hPcard_le
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.card_pos hpow_dvd_cardP
  have hrel : H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = p ^ a := by
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (pow_pos hp.pos _)
    calc
      p ^ b * H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = Nat.card P := by
        rw [← hinterCard]
        exact hPcard_tower
      _ = p ^ b * p ^ a := by rw [hPcard, pow_add]
  have hstab :
      MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G) := by
    ext g
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    have hsmul : g • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = (((g : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one, QuotientGroup.eq]
    simp only [mul_one, Subgroup.inv_mem_iff, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
  have horbit : MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = Set.univ :=
    (Set.eq_univ_iff_ncard (MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H))).2 <| by
        calc
          (MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)).ncard =
              (MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)).index :=
            (MulAction.index_stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)).symm
          _ = H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) := by rw [hstab]; rfl
          _ = p ^ a := hrel
          _ = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by rw [← H.index_eq_card, hindex]
  have hpre : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) := ⟨by
    intro y z
    have hy : y ∈ MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := by rw [horbit]; trivial
    have hz : z ∈ MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := by rw [horbit]; trivial
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨s * r⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rw [← hr, ← hs]
    simp [smul_smul]⟩
  exact ⟨P, hpre, hrel⟩

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.pretransitive_quotient_of_le
proof:
:= by
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) := hpre
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rintro ⟨g⟩ ⟨g'⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp'⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq P ((g : G) : G ⧸ H) ((g' : G) : G ⧸ H)
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  apply QuotientGroup.eq.mpr
  exact hHK (QuotientGroup.eq.mp hp')

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.relIndex_eq_index_of_pretransitive
proof:
:= by
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ K) := pretransitive_quotient_of_le hpre hHK
  have hstab :
      MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = K.subgroupOf P := by
    ext g
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    have hsmul : g • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = (((g : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ K) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one, QuotientGroup.eq]
    simp only [mul_one, Subgroup.inv_mem_iff, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
  calc
    K.relIndex P = (K.subgroupOf P).index := rfl
    _ = (MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K)).index := by rw [hstab]
    _ = Nat.card (G ⧸ K) := MulAction.index_stabilizer_of_transitive P _
    _ = K.index := rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.subgroupOf_injective_of_pretransitive
proof:
:= by
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) := hpre
  intro K hHK L hHL heq
  change K.subgroupOf P = L.subgroupOf P at heq
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hgK
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
      MulAction.exists_smul_eq P (((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)) ((g : G) : G ⧸ H)
    have hsmul : p • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = (((p : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one] at hp
    have hpgH : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ H := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hp
    have hpgK : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ K := hHK hpgH
    have hpK : (p : G) ∈ K := by
      have := K.mul_mem hgK (K.inv_mem hpgK)
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    have hpL : (p : G) ∈ L := by
      have hpSub : p ∈ K.subgroupOf P := hpK
      rw [heq] at hpSub
      exact hpSub
    have hpgL : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ L := hHL hpgH
    have := L.mul_mem hpL hpgL
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this
  · intro g hgL
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
      MulAction.exists_smul_eq P (((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)) ((g : G) : G ⧸ H)
    have hsmul : p • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = (((p : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one] at hp
    have hpgH : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ H := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hp
    have hpgL : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ L := hHL hpgH
    have hpL : (p : G) ∈ L := by
      have := L.mul_mem hgL (L.inv_mem hpgL)
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    have hpK : (p : G) ∈ K := by
      have hpSub : p ∈ L.subgroupOf P := hpL
      rw [← heq] at hpSub
      exact hpSub
    have hpgK : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ K := hHK hpgH
    have := K.mul_mem hpK hpgK
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.primePowerLayer_card_le
statement:
theorem primePowerLayer_card_le {p a k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (H : Subgroup G)
    (hindex : H.index = p ^ a) :
    (primePowerLayer p k H ⊤).card ≤ qBinom p a k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hpre, hrel⟩ := exists_sylow_pretransitive_of_index_primePower hp H hindex
  let target := primePowerLayer p k (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) (⊤ : Subgroup P)
  let source := primePowerLayer p k H ⊤
  have hmaps : (source : Set (Subgroup G)).MapsTo (fun K ↦ K.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) target := by
    intro K hK
    have hKl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hK
    apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
    refine ⟨Subgroup.comap_mono hKl.1, le_top, ?_⟩
    have hKi : K.index = p ^ k := by simpa using hKl.2.2
    have hKP : K.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = p ^ k :=
      (relIndex_eq_index_of_pretransitive hpre hKl.1).trans hKi
    simpa using
      (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := K) (K := (P : Subgroup G))
        (L := (P : Subgroup G)) le_rfl).trans hKP
  have hinj : (source : Set (Subgroup G)).InjOn (fun K ↦ K.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) :=
    (subgroupOf_injective_of_pretransitive hpre).mono fun _ h ↦
      (mem_primePowerLayer.mp h).1
  calc
    source.card ≤ target.card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    _ ≤ qBinom p a k := pGroup_primePowerLayer_card_le hp P.2
      (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) hrel k

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.mem_intermediateSubgroups
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_intermediateSubgroups {H K : Subgroup G} :
    K ∈ intermediateSubgroups H ↔ H ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  simp [intermediateSubgroups]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intermediateSubgroups_card_eq_Ici
statement:
theorem intermediateSubgroups_card_eq_Ici (H : Subgroup G) :
    (intermediateSubgroups H).card = Fintype.card (Set.Ici H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ↑(intermediateSubgroups H) ≃ Set.Ici H :=
    { toFun := fun K ↦ ⟨K.1, mem_intermediateSubgroups.mp K.2⟩
      invFun := fun K ↦ ⟨K.1, mem_intermediateSubgroups.mpr K.2⟩
      left_inv := by intro K; rfl
      right_inv := by intro K; rfl }
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
  exact Fintype.card_congr e

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intermediateSubgroups_card_le_totalQBinom
statement:
theorem intermediateSubgroups_card_le_totalQBinom {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hindex : H.index = p ^ a) :
    (intermediateSubgroups H).card ≤ totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let layers : Finset (Subgroup G) :=
    (Finset.range (a + 1)).biUnion fun k ↦ primePowerLayer p k H ⊤
  have hcover : intermediateSubgroups H ⊆ layers := by
    intro K hK
    have hHK := mem_intermediateSubgroups.mp hK
    have hdvd : K.index ∣ p ^ a := by
      rw [← hindex]
      exact H.index_dvd_of_le hHK
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkindex⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp hdvd
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
      ⟨hHK, le_top, by simpa using hkindex⟩⟩
  calc
    (intermediateSubgroups H).card ≤ layers.card := Finset.card_le_card hcover
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), (primePowerLayer p k H ⊤).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), qBinom p a k := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ ↦ primePowerLayer_card_le hp H hindex
    _ = totalQBinom p a := by
      rw [totalQBinom, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intermediate_interval_card_le_totalQBinom
statement:
theorem intermediate_interval_card_le_totalQBinom {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hindex : H.index = p ^ a) :
    Fintype.card (Set.Ici H) ≤ totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intermediateSubgroups_card_eq_Ici]
  exact intermediateSubgroups_card_le_totalQBinom hp H hindex

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_elementarySubgroup
statement:
theorem card_elementarySubgroup {p a : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (Q : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) :
    Nat.card Q =
      p ^ Module.finrank (ZMod p) (elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a Q)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a Q) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_congr (elementaryCarrierEquiv p a Q)]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod p)
    (V := elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a Q))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementarySubgroup_finrank_eq_sub_of_index
statement:
theorem elementarySubgroup_finrank_eq_sub_of_index {p a k : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (hk : k ≤ a) (Q : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))
    (hindex : Q.index = p ^ k) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) (elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a Q) = a - k
proof:
:= by
  have hcardQ := card_elementarySubgroup Q
  have hcardAmbient : Nat.card (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)) = p ^ a := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod p)
      (V := Fin a → ZMod p))
  have htower := Q.card_mul_index
  have hpowequal :
      p ^ (Module.finrank (ZMod p) (elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a Q) + k) =
        p ^ a := by
    rw [pow_add, ← hcardQ, ← hindex, htower, hcardAmbient]
  have hadd := Nat.pow_right_injective ((Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le) hpowequal
  omega

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementarySubgroup_index_eq_pow_of_finrank
statement:
theorem elementarySubgroup_index_eq_pow_of_finrank {p a k : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (hk : k ≤ a) (Q : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))
    (hrank : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a Q) = a - k) :
    Q.index = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hcardQ := card_elementarySubgroup Q
  have hcardAmbient : Nat.card (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)) = p ^ a := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod p)
      (V := Fin a → ZMod p))
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos _)
  calc
    p ^ (a - k) * Q.index = Nat.card Q * Q.index := by rw [hcardQ, hrank]
    _ = Nat.card (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)) := Q.card_mul_index
    _ = p ^ a := hcardAmbient
    _ = p ^ (a - k) * p ^ k := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementaryAbelian_primePowerLayer_card_eq_qBinom
statement:
theorem elementaryAbelian_primePowerLayer_card_eq_qBinom (p a k : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] (hk : k ≤ a) :
    (primePowerLayer p k
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ⊤).card =
        qBinom p a k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := elementarySubgroupSubmoduleIso p a
  let Target := {W : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin a → ZMod p) //
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) W = a - k}
  let toTarget (Q : ↑(primePowerLayer p k
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ⊤)) : Target := by
    refine ⟨E Q.1, ?_⟩
    have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp Q.2
    apply elementarySubgroup_finrank_eq_sub_of_index hk Q.1
    rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
    exact hQl.2.2
  let fromTarget (W : Target) : ↑(primePowerLayer p k
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ⊤) := by
    refine ⟨E.symm W.1, mem_primePowerLayer.mpr ⟨bot_le, le_top, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
    apply elementarySubgroup_index_eq_pow_of_finrank hk
    change Module.finrank (ZMod p) (E (E.symm W.1)) = a - k
    rw [E.apply_symm_apply]
    exact W.2
  let e : ↑(primePowerLayer p k
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ⊤) ≃ Target :=
    { toFun := toTarget
      invFun := fromTarget
      left_inv := by intro Q; apply Subtype.ext; exact E.symm_apply_apply Q.1
      right_inv := by intro W; apply Subtype.ext; exact E.apply_symm_apply W.1 }
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
  calc
    Fintype.card ↑(primePowerLayer p k
        (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ⊤) =
      Fintype.card Target := Fintype.card_congr e
    _ = Nat.card Target := Fintype.card_eq_nat_card
    _ = qBinom p a (a - k) :=
      card_subspaces_fin_zmod p a (a - k) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
    _ = qBinom p a k := (qBinom_symm (q := p) (n := a) (k := k)
      (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le hk).symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq_totalQBinom
statement:
theorem elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq_totalQBinom (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype.card
        (Set.Ici (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))) = totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let forgetBottom :
      Set.Ici (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ≃
        Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)) :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      invFun := fun K ↦
        ⟨K, (show (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ≤ K from bot_le)⟩
      left_inv := by intro K; rfl
      right_inv := by intro K; rfl }
  calc
    Fintype.card (Set.Ici (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))) =
        Fintype.card (Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) :=
      Fintype.card_congr forgetBottom
    _ = Fintype.card (AddSubgroup (Fin a → ZMod p)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr AddSubgroup.toSubgroup.toEquiv.symm
    _ = Fintype.card (Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin a → ZMod p)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr (AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule p).toEquiv
    _ = totalQBinom p a := by
      rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
      exact card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod p a

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.normal_elementaryAbelian_quotient_interval_card_eq
statement:
theorem normal_elementaryAbelian_quotient_interval_card_eq {p a : ℕ}
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal]
    (e : (G ⧸ H) ≃* Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype.card (Set.Ici H) = totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    Fintype.card (Set.Ici H) = Fintype.card (Subgroup (G ⧸ H)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr (QuotientGroup.comapMk'OrderIso H).toEquiv.symm
    _ = Fintype.card (Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) :=
      Fintype.card_congr e.mapSubgroup.toEquiv
    _ = Fintype.card (AddSubgroup (Fin a → ZMod p)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr AddSubgroup.toSubgroup.toEquiv.symm
    _ = Fintype.card (Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin a → ZMod p)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr (AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule p).toEquiv
    _ = totalQBinom p a := by
      rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
      exact card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod p a

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.product_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq
statement:
theorem product_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq
    (H₀ : Type u) [Group H₀] [Fintype H₀]
    (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype.card
        (Set.Ici ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
          (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))))) =
      totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  exact normal_elementaryAbelian_quotient_interval_card_eq
    ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))))
    (productTopBotQuotientEquiv H₀
      (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.product_elementaryAbelian_index_eq
statement:
theorem product_elementaryAbelian_index_eq
    (H₀ : Type u) [Group H₀] [Fintype H₀]
    (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))).index = p ^ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.index_prod]
  simp only [Subgroup.index_top, one_mul, Subgroup.index_bot]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod p)
    (V := Fin a → ZMod p))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.product_elementaryAbelian_family
statement:
theorem product_elementaryAbelian_family
    (H₀ : Type u) [Group H₀] [Fintype H₀]
    (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))).index = p ^ a ∧
      Fintype.card
          (Set.Ici ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
            (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))))) =
        totalQBinom p a
proof:
:=
  ⟨product_elementaryAbelian_index_eq H₀ p a,
    product_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq H₀ p a⟩

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.product_elementaryAbelian_even_interval_card_eq
statement:
theorem product_elementaryAbelian_even_interval_card_eq
    (H₀ : Type u) [Group H₀] [Fintype H₀]
    (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype.card
        (Set.Ici ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
          (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin (2 * a) → ZMod p))))) =
      totalQBinom p (2 * a)
proof:
:=
  product_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq H₀ p (2 * a)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.product_elementaryAbelian_even_family
statement:
theorem product_elementaryAbelian_even_family
    (H₀ : Type u) [Group H₀] [Fintype H₀]
    (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
      (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin (2 * a) → ZMod p)))).index =
        p ^ (2 * a) ∧
      Fintype.card
          (Set.Ici ((⊤ : Subgroup H₀).prod
            (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin (2 * a) → ZMod p))))) =
        totalQBinom p (2 * a)
proof:
:=
  product_elementaryAbelian_family H₀ p (2 * a)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.primePower_layer_bound_optimal
statement:
theorem primePower_layer_bound_optimal (p a k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hk : k ≤ a) :
    (∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] (H : Subgroup G),
      H.index = p ^ a →
        (primePowerLayer p k H ⊤).card ≤ qBinom p a k) ∧
      (primePowerLayer p k
        (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p))) ⊤).card =
        qBinom p a k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro G _ _ H hindex
    exact primePowerLayer_card_le Fact.out H hindex
  · exact elementaryAbelian_primePowerLayer_card_eq_qBinom p a k hk

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.primePower_interval_bound_optimal
statement:
theorem primePower_interval_bound_optimal (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] (H : Subgroup G), H.index = p ^ a →
      Fintype.card (Set.Ici H) ≤ totalQBinom p a) ∧
    Fintype.card
        (Set.Ici (⊥ : Subgroup (Multiplicative (Fin a → ZMod p)))) = totalQBinom p a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro G _ _ H hindex
    exact intermediate_interval_card_le_totalQBinom Fact.out H hindex
  · exact elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq_totalQBinom p a

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.exact_decimal_comparison
statement:
private theorem exact_decimal_comparison :
    eulerUpper20 * thetaUpper4 < (3685984401 : ℝ) / 500000000
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [eulerUpper20, thetaUpper4, Finset.prod_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub
statement:
private lemma one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub { α : Type* } [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (x : α → ℝ)
    (hx0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ x i) (hx1 : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ≤ 1) :
    1 - ∑ i ∈ s, x i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - x i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha]
      have hxa0 : 0 ≤ x a := hx0 a (by simp)
      have hxa1 : x a ≤ 1 := hx1 a (by simp)
      have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, x i :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi ↦ hx0 i (by simp [hi])
      calc
        1 - (x a + ∑ i ∈ s, x i) ≤
            (1 - x a) * (1 - ∑ i ∈ s, x i) := by
              nlinarith [mul_nonneg hxa0 hsum0]
        _ ≤ (1 - x a) * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - x i) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (ih (fun i hi ↦ hx0 i (by simp [hi]))
              (fun i hi ↦ hx1 i (by simp [hi]))) (sub_nonneg.mpr hxa1)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.dyadic_euler_tail_product_lower
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (20 + n + 1)) ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 20 := by
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (20 + n + 1)) =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 21 *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro n hn
              rw [← pow_add]
              congr 1
              omega
      _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 21 * 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_geometric_two_le k) (by positivity)
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 20 := by norm_num
  calc
    1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 20 ≤
        1 - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (20 + n + 1) :=
      sub_le_sub_left hsum 1
    _ ≤ ∏ n ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (20 + n + 1)) :=
      one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub _ _
        (fun n hn ↦ pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
        (fun n hn ↦ pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.one_le_dyadic_euler_factor
statement:
private lemma one_le_dyadic_euler_factor (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) < 1 :=
    pow_lt_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by positivity
  exact (one_le_inv₀ (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.dyadic_euler_partial_nonneg
statement:
private lemma dyadic_euler_partial_nonneg (r : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∏ n ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun n hn ↦
    zero_le_one.trans (one_le_dyadic_euler_factor n)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.eulerUpper20_nonneg
statement: private lemma eulerUpper20_nonneg : 0 ≤ eulerUpper20
proof:
:= by

    (zero_le_one.trans ((one_le_inv₀ (by norm_num)).2 (by norm_num)))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.dyadic_euler_partial_le
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r ≤ 20
  · have hprefix :
        (∏ n ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹) ≤
          ∏ n ∈ Finset.range 20, (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
      · exact Finset.range_mono hr
      · intro n hn
        exact zero_le_one.trans (one_le_dyadic_euler_factor n)
      · intro n hn hnr
        exact one_le_dyadic_euler_factor n
    have htail : 1 ≤ (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 20)⁻¹ :=
      (one_le_inv₀ (by norm_num)).2 (by norm_num)
    exact hprefix.trans (by
      rw [eulerUpper20]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (dyadic_euler_partial_nonneg 20) htail)
  · have h20 : 20 ≤ r := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h20
    rw [Finset.prod_range_add]
    have htailpos :
        0 < ∏ n ∈ Finset.range k,
          (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (20 + n + 1)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro n hn
      exact sub_pos.mpr (pow_lt_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega))
    have hbasepos : 0 < 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 20 := by norm_num
    have htail :
        (∏ n ∈ Finset.range k,
            (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (20 + n + 1))⁻¹) ≤
          (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 20)⁻¹ := by
      have hinv := (inv_le_inv₀ htailpos hbasepos).2
        (dyadic_euler_tail_product_lower k)
      simpa only [Finset.prod_inv_distrib] using hinv
    rw [eulerUpper20]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by positivity)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussian_two_nat
proof:
:= by
  rw [show -Real.log 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 =
      (n ^ 2 : ℕ) * (-Real.log 2) by norm_num [Nat.cast_pow]; ring]
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussianTheta_two_eq
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℤ → ℝ := fun z ↦ Real.exp (-Real.log 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 2)
  have hf : Summable f := gaussianTheta_summable (p := (2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have hpos : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ f (n + 1)) := by
    exact hf.comp_injective (fun a b h ↦ by omega)
  have hneg : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ f (-(n + 1))) := by
    exact hf.comp_injective (fun a b h ↦ by omega)
  rw [gaussianTheta, tsum_of_add_one_of_neg_add_one hpos hneg]
  have hpos_eq :
      (∑' n : ℕ, f (n + 1)) =
        ∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2) := by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    simpa [f] using gaussian_two_nat (n + 1)
  have hneg_eq :
      (∑' n : ℕ, f (-(n + 1))) =
        ∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2) := by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    dsimp [f]
    convert gaussian_two_nat (n + 1) using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring
  rw [hpos_eq, hneg_eq]
  simp [f]
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.dyadic_theta_summable
statement:
private lemma dyadic_theta_summable :

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.dyadic_theta_tail_le
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 25 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 11) ^ n
  have hg : Summable g := by
    exact (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity)
      (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 11 < 1)).mul_left _
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 4 + 1) ^ 2) ≤ g n := by
    intro n
    have hn : 25 + 11 * n ≤ (n + 4 + 1) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [Nat.le_mul_self n]
    calc
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 4 + 1) ^ 2) ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (25 + 11 * n) :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hn
      _ = g n := by simp [g, pow_add, pow_mul]
  have hf : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 4 + 1) ^ 2)) :=
    hg.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n ↦ by positivity) hterm
  calc
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n + 4 + 1) ^ 2)) ≤ ∑' n, g n :=
      hf.tsum_le_tsum hterm hg
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 25 * (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 11)⁻¹ := by
      rw [show (∑' n, g n) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 25 *
          ∑' n : ℕ, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 11) ^ n by
        simp only [g, tsum_mul_left]]
      rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) (by norm_num)]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussianTheta_two_le

  nlinarith

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.sharpConstant_two_decimal_enclosure

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.packedRawMap_injective
statement:
theorem packedRawMap_injective (H : Subgroup G) (q r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (packedRawMap H q r)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨K, x⟩ ⟨L, y⟩ hxy
  have htuple : x.1 = y.1 := hxy
  have hKLval : K.1 = L.1 := by
    rw [← x.2.2, ← y.2.2, htuple]
  have hKL : K = L := Subtype.ext hKLval
  subst L
  have hxy' : x = y := Subtype.ext htuple
  subst y
  rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.packed_raw_card_bound
statement:
theorem packed_raw_card_bound (H : Subgroup G) (q r : ℕ) :
    (∑ K : band H q r, Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r)) ≤ Nat.card G ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (packedRawMap H q r)
    (packedRawMap_injective H q r)
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.refl (Fin r → G))] at hcard
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin] using hcard

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_relative_escape_raw
statement:
theorem band_relative_escape_raw {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac)
    (K : band H q r) :
    gammaQ q r * (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r ≤
      (Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : H.relIndex K.1 < H.index.minFac ^ (r + 1) :=
    K.2.2.2.trans_le (pow_le_pow_left' hqp _)
  apply le_trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gammaQ_mono_base hq hqp) (by positivity))
  exact relative_escape_raw hn K.2.1 hupper

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_raw_sum_bound
statement:
theorem band_raw_sum_bound {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) :
    gammaQ q r *
        (∑ K : band H q r, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) ≤
      (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gammaQ q r * (∑ K : band H q r, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) =
        ∑ K : band H q r,
          gammaQ q r * (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ K : band H q r,
        (Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) : ℚ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun K _ => band_relative_escape_raw hn hq hqp K
    _ ≤ (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r := by
      exact_mod_cast packed_raw_card_bound H q r

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.bandwise_moment
statement:
theorem bandwise_moment {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) (r : ℕ) :
    gammaQ q r *
        (∑ K : band H q r, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) ≤
      (H.index : ℚ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := band_raw_sum_bound hn hq hqp (r := r)
  have hsum :
      (∑ K : band H q r, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) =
        (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r *
          (∑ K : band H q r, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro K hK
    rw [← card_mul_relIndex K.2.1, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow]
  have hGcard : Nat.card H * H.index = Nat.card G := H.card_mul_index
