  have hGpow :
      (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r =
        (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := by
    rw [← hGcard, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow]
  have hHpos : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r :=
    pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Nat.card_pos) _
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hHpos
  calc
    (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r *
          (gammaQ q r *
            (∑ K : band H q r, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r)) =
        gammaQ q r *
          (∑ K : band H q r, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) := by
      rw [hsum]
      ring
    _ ≤ (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r := hraw
    _ = (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := hGpow

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.bandwise_moment_nat
statement:
theorem bandwise_moment_nat {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) (r : ℕ) :
    gammaNum q r *
        (∑ K : band H q r, H.relIndex K.1 ^ r) ≤
      gammaDen q r * H.index ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hdenPos : 0 < gammaDen q r := pow_pos (by omega) _
  have h := bandwise_moment hn hq hqp r
  rw [gammaQ] at h
  have hqRat :
      (gammaNum q r : ℚ) *
          (∑ K : band H q r, H.relIndex K.1 ^ r) ≤
        (gammaDen q r : ℚ) * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := by
    calc
      (gammaNum q r : ℚ) *
            (∑ K : band H q r, H.relIndex K.1 ^ r) =
          (gammaDen q r : ℚ) *
            ((gammaNum q r : ℚ) / gammaDen q r *
              (∑ K : band H q r,
                (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r)) := by
        simp only [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_pow]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (gammaDen q r : ℚ) * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast hqRat

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_card_mul_pow_le_moment
statement:
theorem band_card_mul_pow_le_moment (H : Subgroup G) (q r : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (band H q r) * q ^ (r * r) ≤
      ∑ K : band H q r, H.relIndex K.1 ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ _K : band H q r, q ^ (r * r)) ≤
      ∑ K : band H q r, H.relIndex K.1 ^ r := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro K hK
    change q ^ (r * r) ≤ H.relIndex K.1 ^ r
    rw [pow_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left' K.2.2.1 _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc
    Fintype.card (band H q r) * q ^ (r * r) =
        ∑ _K : band H q r, q ^ (r * r) := by
      simp [Nat.mul_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ K : band H q r, H.relIndex K.1 ^ r := hsum

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_card_bound_nat
statement:
theorem band_card_bound_nat {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) (r : ℕ) :
    gammaNum q r * (Nat.card (band H q r) * q ^ (r * r)) ≤
      gammaDen q r * H.index ^ r
proof:
:= by
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (band_card_mul_pow_le_moment H q r)).trans
    (bandwise_moment_nat hn hq hqp r)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_card_bound
statement:
theorem band_card_bound {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) (r : ℕ) :
    (Nat.card (band H q r) : ℚ) ≤
      (H.index : ℚ) ^ r /
        (gammaQ q r * (q : ℚ) ^ (r * r))
proof:
:= by
  have hmass := band_card_mul_pow_le_moment H q r
  have hmoment := bandwise_moment hn hq hqp r
  have hgamma : 0 < gammaQ q r := gammaQ_pos hq
  have hqpow : (0 : ℚ) < (q : ℚ) ^ (r * r) := by positivity
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hgamma hqpow)).2
  calc
    (Nat.card (band H q r) : ℚ) *
          (gammaQ q r * (q : ℚ) ^ (r * r)) =
        gammaQ q r *
          ((Nat.card (band H q r) : ℚ) * (q : ℚ) ^ (r * r)) := by
      ring
    _ ≤ gammaQ q r *
          (∑ K : band H q r, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hgamma.le
      exact_mod_cast hmass
    _ ≤ (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := hmoment

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_zero_eq_bottom
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : H < K.1 := lt_of_le_of_ne K.2.1 (Ne.symm hne)
  have hmin : H.index.minFac ≤ H.relIndex K.1 :=
    minFac_le_relIndex_of_lt (le_refl H) hlt
  have hupper : H.relIndex K.1 < q := by
    simpa using K.2.2.2
  omega

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_zero_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [band_zero_eq_bottom hq hqp K, band_zero_eq_bottom hq hqp L]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.band_zero_card_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  let b : band H q 0 := ⟨H, le_rfl, by simp, by simpa using hq⟩
  let e : band H q 0 ≃ PUnit.{u + 1} :=
    { toFun := fun _ => PUnit.unit
      invFun := fun _ => b
      left_inv := fun K => (band_zero_subsingleton hq hqp K b).symm
      right_inv := by intro z; cases z; rfl }
  rw [Nat.card_congr e]
  simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.bandSigmaToInterval_intervalToBandSigma
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bandSigmaToInterval_intervalToBandSigma (H : Subgroup G) (q : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 < H.index) (hq : 1 < q) (K : interval H) :
    bandSigmaToInterval H q (intervalToBandSigma H q hn hq K) = K
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intervalToBandSigma_injective
statement:
theorem intervalToBandSigma_injective (H : Subgroup G) (q : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 < H.index) (hq : 1 < q) :
    Function.Injective (intervalToBandSigma H q hn hq)
proof:
:= by
  intro K L h
  have := congrArg (bandSigmaToInterval H q) h
  simpa using this

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intermediate_unique_band
statement:
theorem intermediate_unique_band (H : Subgroup G) (q : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 < H.index) (hq : 1 < q) (K : interval H) :
    ∃! r : Fin (Nat.log q H.index + 1),
      q ^ (r : ℕ) ≤ H.relIndex K.1 ∧
        H.relIndex K.1 < q ^ ((r : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let m := H.relIndex K.1
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    letI : H.IsFiniteRelIndex K.1 := H.isFiniteRelIndex_of_finiteIndex
    exact Subgroup.relIndex_ne_zero
  have hmn : m ≤ H.index :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (H.relIndex_dvd_index_of_le K.2)
  have hrle : Nat.log q m ≤ Nat.log q H.index := Nat.log_mono_right hmn
  refine ⟨⟨Nat.log q m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hrle⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨Nat.pow_log_le_self q hm0, Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self hq m⟩
  · intro r hr
    apply Fin.ext
    exact (Nat.log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow hr.1 hr.2).symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.finiteU_bound
statement:
theorem finiteU_bound {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℚ) ≤ finiteUQ H.index q
proof:
:= by
  have hcardNat : Fintype.card (interval H) ≤
      Fintype.card (Σ r : Fin (Nat.log q H.index + 1), band H q r.1) :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective (intervalToBandSigma H q hn hq)
      (intervalToBandSigma_injective H q hn hq)
  have hcard : (Nat.card (interval H) : ℚ) ≤
      ∑ r : Fin (Nat.log q H.index + 1),
        (Nat.card (band H q (r : ℕ)) : ℚ) := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    simp_rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma] at hcardNat
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  calc
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℚ) ≤
        ∑ r : Fin (Nat.log q H.index + 1),
          (Nat.card (band H q (r : ℕ)) : ℚ) := hcard
    _ ≤ ∑ r : Fin (Nat.log q H.index + 1),
        (H.index : ℚ) ^ (r : ℕ) /
          (gammaQ q (r : ℕ) *
            (q : ℚ) ^ ((r : ℕ) * (r : ℕ))) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ => band_card_bound hn hq hqp (r : ℕ)
    _ = finiteUQ H.index q := rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.packedLayerRawMap_injective
statement:
theorem packedLayerRawMap_injective (H : Subgroup G) (m r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (packedLayerRawMap H m r)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨K, x⟩ ⟨L, y⟩ hxy
  have htuple : x.1 = y.1 := hxy
  have hKLval : K.1 = L.1 := by
    rw [← x.2.2, ← y.2.2, htuple]
  have hKL : K = L := Subtype.ext hKLval
  subst L
  have hxy' : x = y := Subtype.ext htuple
  subst y
  rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.packed_layer_raw_card_bound
statement:
theorem packed_layer_raw_card_bound (H : Subgroup G) (m r : ℕ) :
    (∑ K : layer H m, Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r)) ≤ Nat.card G ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (packedLayerRawMap H m r)
    (packedLayerRawMap_injective H m r)
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.refl (Fin r → G))] at hcard
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin] using hcard

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.layer_relative_escape_raw
statement:
theorem layer_relative_escape_raw {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r m : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac)
    (hmi : m < q ^ (r + 1)) (K : layer H m) :
    gammaQ q r * (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r ≤
      (Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : H.relIndex K.1 < H.index.minFac ^ (r + 1) := by
    rw [K.2.2]
    exact hmi.trans_le (pow_le_pow_left' hqp _)
  apply le_trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gammaQ_mono_base hq hqp) (by positivity))
  exact relative_escape_raw hn K.2.1 hupper

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.layer_raw_sum_bound
statement:
theorem layer_raw_sum_bound {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r m : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac)
    (hmi : m < q ^ (r + 1)) :
    gammaQ q r *
        (∑ K : layer H m, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) ≤
      (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gammaQ q r * (∑ K : layer H m, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) =
        ∑ K : layer H m,
          gammaQ q r * (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ K : layer H m,
        (Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) : ℚ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun K _ => layer_relative_escape_raw hn hq hqp hmi K
    _ ≤ (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r := by
      exact_mod_cast packed_layer_raw_card_bound H m r

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.layer_card_moment
statement:
theorem layer_card_moment {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r m : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac)
    (hmi : m < q ^ (r + 1)) :
    gammaQ q r * (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r ≤
      (H.index : ℚ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := layer_raw_sum_bound hn hq hqp hmi
  have hsum :
      (∑ K : layer H m, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) =
        (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r *
          (∑ K : layer H m, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro K hK
    rw [← card_mul_relIndex K.2.1, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow]
  have hlayerSum :
      (∑ K : layer H m, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) =
        (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r := by
    calc
      (∑ K : layer H m, (H.relIndex K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) =
          ∑ _K : layer H m, (m : ℚ) ^ r := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro K hK
        rw [K.2.2]
      _ = (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r := by
        simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hGcard : Nat.card H * H.index = Nat.card G := H.card_mul_index
  have hGpow :
      (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r =
        (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := by
    rw [← hGcard, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow]
  have hHpos : (0 : ℚ) < (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r :=
    pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Nat.card_pos) _
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hHpos
  calc
    (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r *
          (gammaQ q r * (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r) =
        gammaQ q r *
          (∑ K : layer H m, (Nat.card K.1 : ℚ) ^ r) := by
      rw [hsum, hlayerSum]
      ring
    _ ≤ (Nat.card G : ℚ) ^ r := hraw
    _ = (Nat.card H : ℚ) ^ r * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := hGpow

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.layer_card_bound_nat
statement:
theorem layer_card_bound_nat {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r m : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac)
    (hmi : m < q ^ (r + 1)) :
    gammaNum q r * (Nat.card (layer H m) * m ^ r) ≤
      gammaDen q r * H.index ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hdenPos : 0 < gammaDen q r := pow_pos (by omega) _
  have h := layer_card_moment hn hq hqp hmi
  rw [gammaQ] at h
  have hqRat :
      (gammaNum q r : ℚ) *
          ((Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r) ≤
        (gammaDen q r : ℚ) * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := by
    calc
      (gammaNum q r : ℚ) *
            ((Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r) =
          (gammaDen q r : ℚ) *
            ((gammaNum q r : ℚ) / gammaDen q r *
              (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r) := by
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (gammaDen q r : ℚ) * (H.index : ℚ) ^ r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast hqRat

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.layer_card_bound
statement:
theorem layer_card_bound {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q r m : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac)
    (hlo : q ^ r ≤ m) (hhi : m < q ^ (r + 1)) :
    (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) ≤
      (H.index : ℚ) ^ r /
        (gammaQ q r * (m : ℚ) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  have hmPos : 0 < m := lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos (by omega) r) hlo
  have hdenPos : (0 : ℚ) < gammaQ q r * (m : ℚ) ^ r :=
    mul_pos (gammaQ_pos hq) (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hmPos) _)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hdenPos).2
  calc
    (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) *
          (gammaQ q r * (m : ℚ) ^ r) =
        gammaQ q r * (Nat.card (layer H m) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ r := by
      ring
    _ ≤ (H.index : ℚ) ^ r := layer_card_moment hn hq hqp hhi

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.rawHTranslate_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro h k heq
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hi := congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val heq) i
  exact mul_left_cancel hi

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.cardH_pow_le_rawRelGen
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype H := Fintype.ofFinite H
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (rawHTranslate hHK x)
    (rawHTranslate_injective hHK x)
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] using hcard

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.escapePath_nonempty
statement:
theorem escapePath_nonempty (K : Subgroup G) (r : ℕ) (s : EscapeState K) :
    Nonempty (EscapePath K r s)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing s with
  | zero => exact ⟨PUnit.unit⟩
  | succ r ih =>
      obtain ⟨x⟩ := escapeChoiceNonempty K s
      obtain ⟨z⟩ := ih (escapeNext K s x)
      exact ⟨escapeCons K x z⟩

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.packedIntervalRawMap_injective
statement:
theorem packedIntervalRawMap_injective (H : Subgroup G) (r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (packedIntervalRawMap H r)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨K, x⟩ ⟨L, y⟩ hxy
  have htuple : x.1 = y.1 := hxy
  have hKLval : K.1 = L.1 := by
    rw [← x.2.2, ← y.2.2, htuple]
  have hKL : K = L := Subtype.ext hKLval
  subst L
  have hxy' : x = y := Subtype.ext htuple
  subst y
  rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.packed_interval_raw_card_bound
statement:
theorem packed_interval_raw_card_bound (H : Subgroup G) (r : ℕ) :
    (∑ K : interval H, Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r)) ≤ Nat.card G ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (packedIntervalRawMap H r)
    (packedIntervalRawMap_injective H r)
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.refl (Fin r → G))] at hcard
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin] using hcard

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementary_interval_bound
statement:
theorem elementary_interval_bound {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    Nat.card (interval H) ≤ H.index ^ Nat.log 2 H.index
proof:
:= by
  let r := Nat.log 2 H.index
  have heach : ∀ K : interval H,
      Nat.card H ^ r ≤ Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) := fun K =>
    cardH_pow_le_rawRelGen K.2 (elementaryRawTuple H hn K)
  have hlower : Nat.card (interval H) * Nat.card H ^ r ≤
      ∑ K : interval H, Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    calc
      Fintype.card (interval H) * Nat.card H ^ r =
          ∑ _K : interval H, Nat.card H ^ r := by
        simp
      _ ≤ ∑ K : interval H, Nat.card (RawRelGen H K.1 r) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun K _ => heach K
  have hpack := packed_interval_raw_card_bound H r
  have htotal := hlower.trans hpack
  have hGcard : Nat.card H * H.index = Nat.card G := H.card_mul_index
  have hGpow : Nat.card G ^ r = Nat.card H ^ r * H.index ^ r := by
    rw [← hGcard, mul_pow]
  rw [hGpow] at htotal
  change Nat.card (interval H) ≤ H.index ^ r
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (c := Nat.card H ^ r)
    (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using htotal)
    (pow_pos Nat.card_pos _)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_top_card_eq_one
statement:
theorem interval_top_card_eq_one :
    Nat.card (interval (⊤ : Subgroup G)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : interval (⊤ : Subgroup G) ≃ PUnit.{u + 1} :=
    { toFun := fun _ => PUnit.unit
      invFun := fun _ => ⟨⊤, le_rfl⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro K
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (top_unique K.2).symm
      right_inv := by intro z; cases z; rfl }
  rw [Nat.card_congr e]
  simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementary_interval_bound_all
statement:
theorem elementary_interval_bound_all (H : Subgroup G) :
    Nat.card (interval H) ≤ H.index ^ Nat.log 2 H.index
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 1 < H.index
  · exact elementary_interval_bound hn
  · have hpos : 0 < H.index :=
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite
    have hi : H.index = 1 := by omega
    have htop : H = ⊤ := Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp hi
    subst H
    rw [interval_top_card_eq_one]
    simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intervalStrictDecode_encode
statement:
theorem intervalStrictDecode_encode (H : Subgroup G) (K : interval H) :
    intervalStrictDecode H (intervalStrictEncode H K) = K
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hKH : K.1 = H
  · rw [intervalStrictEncode, dif_pos hKH]
    change (⟨H, le_rfl⟩ : interval H) = K
    exact Subtype.ext hKH.symm
  · by_cases hKG : K.1 = ⊤
    · rw [intervalStrictEncode, dif_neg hKH, dif_pos hKG]
      change (⟨⊤, le_top⟩ : interval H) = K
      exact Subtype.ext hKG.symm
    · rw [intervalStrictEncode, dif_neg hKH, dif_neg hKG]
      rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.intervalStrictEncode_decode
statement:
theorem intervalStrictEncode_decode (H : Subgroup G) (hHt : H < ⊤)
    (z : strictIntermediate H ⊕ Bool) :
    intervalStrictEncode H (intervalStrictDecode H z) = z
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | inl K =>
      have hKH : K.1 ≠ H := K.2.1.ne'
      have hKG : K.1 ≠ ⊤ := K.2.2.ne
      change (if hKH' : K.1 = H then Sum.inr false
        else if hKG' : K.1 = ⊤ then Sum.inr true
        else Sum.inl ⟨K.1, lt_of_le_of_ne K.2.1.le (Ne.symm hKH'),
          lt_of_le_of_ne le_top hKG'⟩) = Sum.inl K
      rw [dif_neg hKH, dif_neg hKG]
      congr
  | inr b =>
      cases b
      · simp [intervalStrictEncode, intervalStrictDecode]
      · simp [intervalStrictEncode, intervalStrictDecode, hHt.ne.symm]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.strictIntermediate_card_add_two
statement:
theorem strictIntermediate_card_add_two (H : Subgroup G) (hHt : H < ⊤) :
    Nat.card (strictIntermediate H) + 2 = Nat.card (interval H)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (strictIntermediate H ⊕ Bool) := inferInstance
  have hcard := Fintype.card_congr (intervalStrictEquiv H hHt)
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simpa using hcard.symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.strictIntermediate_card_eq_sub_two
statement:
theorem strictIntermediate_card_eq_sub_two (H : Subgroup G) (hHt : H < ⊤) :
    Nat.card (strictIntermediate H) = Nat.card (interval H) - 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := strictIntermediate_card_add_two H hHt
  omega

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.euler_factor_eq_one_add
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerCorrection, div_eq_mul_inv]
  calc
    (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ =
        ((1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)) + p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)) *
          (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by rw [sub_add_cancel, one_mul]
    _ = 1 + p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [add_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.eulerCorrection_nonneg
statement:
private lemma eulerCorrection_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ eulerCorrection p n
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le
  have hq_half : p⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hp
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) := pow_nonneg hq0 _
  have ht_half : p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) ≤ p⁻¹ ^ 1 :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 (hq_half.trans (by norm_num)) (by omega)
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by simpa using hq_half
  exact div_nonneg ht0 (by linarith)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.eulerCorrection_le
statement:
private lemma eulerCorrection_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) :
    eulerCorrection p n ≤ 2 * p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le
  have hq_half : p⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hp
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) := pow_nonneg hq0 _
  have ht_half : p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) ≤ p⁻¹ ^ 1 :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 (hq_half.trans (by norm_num)) (by omega)
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by simpa using hq_half
  rw [eulerCorrection, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.mpr (by linarith : 2 * p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) ≤ 1))]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.summable_eulerCorrection
statement:
lemma summable_eulerCorrection {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Summable (eulerCorrection p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le
  have hq1 : p⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
  have hgeom : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)) := by
    simpa using (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1)
  exact (hgeom.mul_left 2).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun n ↦ eulerCorrection_nonneg hp n) (fun n ↦ eulerCorrection_le hp n)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.multipliable_euler_factors
statement:
lemma multipliable_euler_factors {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Multipliable (fun n : ℕ ↦ (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := summable_eulerCorrection hp
  have habs (n : ℕ) : |eulerCorrection p n| = eulerCorrection p n :=
    abs_of_nonneg (eulerCorrection_nonneg hp n)
  have hm : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ ↦ 1 + eulerCorrection p n) :=
    multipliable_one_add_of_summable (by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, habs] using hs)
  refine hm.congr ?_
  intro n
  symm
  apply euler_factor_eq_one_add
  have := eulerCorrection_nonneg hp n
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq1 : p⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
  have hpow : p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) < 1 :=
    (pow_lt_one₀ (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le hq1 (by omega))
  linarith

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.eulerC_partial_tendsto
statement:
lemma eulerC_partial_tendsto {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℕ ↦ ∏ n ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹)
      atTop (nhds (eulerC p))
proof:
:= by
  exact (multipliable_euler_factors hp).tendsto_prod_tprod_nat

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.euler_partial_pos
statement:
private lemma euler_partial_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (r : ℕ) :
    0 < ∏ n ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro n hn
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq1 : p⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
  exact inv_pos.mpr (sub_pos.mpr (pow_lt_one₀ (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le hq1 (by omega)))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.euler_partial_strictMono
statement:
private lemma euler_partial_strictMono {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    StrictMono (fun r : ℕ ↦ ∏ n ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro r
  rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < p⁻¹ ^ (r + 1) := pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hp0) _
  have hq1 : p⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - p⁻¹ ^ (r + 1) :=
    sub_pos.mpr (pow_lt_one₀ (inv_pos.mpr hp0).le hq1 (by omega))
  have hfactor : 1 < (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (r + 1))⁻¹ := by
    exact (one_lt_inv₀ hden).2 (by linarith)
  nlinarith [euler_partial_pos hp r]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.eulerC_pos
statement: lemma eulerC_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : 0 < eulerC p
proof:
:= by
  have hmono := (euler_partial_strictMono hp).monotone
  have hlim := eulerC_partial_tendsto hp
  have hle := hmono.ge_of_tendsto hlim 1
  have hzero : (1 : ℝ) < ∏ n ∈ Finset.range 1,
      (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by
    simpa using (euler_partial_strictMono hp (Nat.zero_lt_one))
  linarith

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC
statement:
lemma gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (r : ℕ) :
    (gammaR p r)⁻¹ < eulerC p
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : (gammaR p r)⁻¹ =
      ∏ n ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - p⁻¹ ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by
    simp [gammaR, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  rw [hfinite]
  have hs := euler_partial_strictMono hp
  have hle := hs.monotone.ge_of_tendsto (eulerC_partial_tendsto hp) (r + 1)
  exact (hs (Nat.lt_succ_self r)).trans_le hle

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.summable_int_gaussian
statement:
lemma summable_int_gaussian {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) :
    Summable (fun z : ℤ ↦ Real.exp (-A * (z : ℝ) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hT : 0 < A / Real.pi := div_pos hA Real.pi_pos
  have h := summable_pow_mul_jacobiTheta₂_term_bound 0 hT 0
  simpa only [pow_zero, Int.cast_one, one_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero] using h.congr
    (fun z ↦ by
      congr 1
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
      ring)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussianTheta_summable
statement:
lemma gaussianTheta_summable {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    Summable (fun z : ℤ ↦ Real.exp (-Real.log p * (z : ℝ) ^ 2))
proof:
:=
  summable_int_gaussian (Real.log_pos hp)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussianTheta_eq_one_add_two_mul_tsum_pnat
statement:
lemma gaussianTheta_eq_one_add_two_mul_tsum_pnat {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    gaussianTheta p = 1 + 2 * ∑' j : ℕ+,
      Real.exp (-Real.log p * (j : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianTheta
  rw [tsum_int_eq_zero_add_two_mul_tsum_pnat]
  · simp
  · intro z
    simp
  · exact gaussianTheta_summable hp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shiftedTheta_summable
statement:
lemma shiftedTheta_summable {p x : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    Summable (fun z : ℤ ↦ Real.exp (-Real.log p * ((z : ℝ) - x) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  let A := Real.log p
  have hA : 0 < A := Real.log_pos hp
  have hbase := summable_int_gaussian (A := A / 2) (by positivity)
  have hmajor := hbase.mul_left (Real.exp (A * x ^ 2))
  refine hmajor.of_norm_bounded (fun z ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
  have hs : 0 ≤ ((z : ℝ) - 2 * x) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hA.le hs]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.gaussianTheta_pos
statement: lemma gaussianTheta_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) : 0 < gaussianTheta p
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianTheta
  apply (gaussianTheta_summable hp).tsum_pos (fun z ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le) 0
  simpa using Real.exp_pos (0 : ℝ)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.sharpConstant_pos
statement: lemma sharpConstant_pos {p : ℝ} (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) : 0 < sharpConstant p
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_pos (eulerC_pos hp2) (gaussianTheta_pos (by linarith))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shifted_gaussian_fourier
statement:
private lemma shifted_gaussian_fourier {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑' z : ℤ, Real.exp (-A * ((z : ℝ) - x) ^ 2)) =
      1 / (A / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ∑' k : ℤ, Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := A / Real.pi
  let b : ℝ := a * x
  have ha : 0 < a := div_pos hA Real.pi_pos
  have hP := Complex.tsum_exp_neg_quadratic
    (a := (a : ℂ)) (by simpa using ha) (b : ℂ)
  let c : ℂ := Complex.exp (-(A : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)
  have hleft :
      (∑' z : ℤ, Complex.exp (-(A : ℂ) * ((z : ℂ) - (x : ℂ)) ^ 2)) =
        c * ∑' z : ℤ,
          Complex.exp (-Real.pi * (a : ℂ) * (z : ℂ) ^ 2 +
            2 * Real.pi * (b : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) := by
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro z
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [c, a, b]
    push_cast
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    ring
  have hright :
      c * (1 / (a : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
          ∑' k : ℤ, Complex.exp (-Real.pi / (a : ℂ) *
            ((k : ℂ) + Complex.I * (b : ℂ)) ^ 2)) =
        1 / (a : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
          ∑' k : ℤ, Complex.exp
            ((-(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) -
              (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm c (1 / (a : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)), mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro k
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [c, a, b]
    push_cast
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, ne_of_gt hA]
    ring_nf
    rw [Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  have hcomplex :
      (∑' z : ℤ, Complex.exp (-(A : ℂ) * ((z : ℂ) - (x : ℂ)) ^ 2)) =
        1 / (a : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
          ∑' k : ℤ, Complex.exp
            ((-(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) -
              (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [hleft, hP, hright]
  have hprimalR : Summable (fun z : ℤ ↦
      Real.exp (-A * ((z : ℝ) - x) ^ 2)) := by
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using shiftedTheta_summable
      (p := Real.exp A) (x := x) (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hA)
  have hprimalTerm (z : ℤ) :
      Complex.exp (-(A : ℂ) * ((z : ℂ) - (x : ℂ)) ^ 2) =
        (Real.exp (-A * ((z : ℝ) - x) ^ 2) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_exp]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hprimalC : Summable (fun z : ℤ ↦
      Complex.exp (-(A : ℂ) * ((z : ℂ) - (x : ℂ)) ^ 2)) := by
    have hcast : Summable (fun z : ℤ ↦
        (Real.exp (-A * ((z : ℝ) - x) ^ 2) : ℂ)) :=
      Complex.summable_ofReal.mpr hprimalR
    exact hcast.congr (fun z ↦ (hprimalTerm z).symm)
  have hdual : Summable (fun k : ℤ ↦ Complex.exp
      ((-(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) -
        (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x : ℝ) * Complex.I)) := by
    have hg := summable_int_gaussian (A := Real.pi ^ 2 / A) (by positivity)
    refine hg.of_norm_bounded (fun k ↦ ?_)
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, sub_zero,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), le_refl]
  have hdualRe (k : ℤ) :
      (Complex.exp
        ((-(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) -
          (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x : ℝ) * Complex.I)).re =
        Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x) := by
    let u : ℝ := -(Real.pi ^ 2 / A) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2
    let v : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x
    change (Complex.exp ((u : ℂ) - (v : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re =
      Real.exp u * Real.cos v
    simp only [Complex.exp_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re,
      Complex.I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, add_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub,
      Real.cos_neg]
  have hpref : 1 / (a : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) =
      ((1 / a ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    symm
    rw [Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_cpow ha.le]
    norm_num
  rw [hpref] at hcomplex
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re hcomplex
  rw [Complex.re_tsum hprimalC, Complex.mul_re, Complex.re_tsum hdual] at hre
  simpa only [hprimalTerm, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, hdualRe,
    zero_mul, sub_zero, a] using hre

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shiftedTheta_le
statement:
lemma shiftedTheta_le {p x : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    shiftedTheta p x ≤ gaussianTheta p
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < Real.log p := Real.log_pos hp
  have hzero : (∑' z : ℤ, Real.exp (-Real.log p * (z : ℝ) ^ 2)) =
      1 / (Real.log p / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ∑' k : ℤ, Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using shifted_gaussian_fourier hA 0
  rw [shiftedTheta, gaussianTheta, shifted_gaussian_fourier hA x, hzero]
  have hweight : Summable (fun k : ℤ ↦
      Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
    summable_int_gaussian (by positivity)
  have hcos : Summable (fun k : ℤ ↦
      Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x)) := by
    exact hweight.of_norm_bounded (fun k ↦ by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      simpa using mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        (Real.abs_cos_le_one (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x)))
  have hpoint : ∀ k : ℤ,
      Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x) ≤
        Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    intro k
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.cos_le_one (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x))
      (Real.exp_nonneg ((-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p)) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2))
  have hsum := hcos.tsum_le_tsum hpoint hweight
  have hpref : 0 ≤ 1 / (Real.log p / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hpref

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.cos_two_pi_lt_one_of_not_integer
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Real.cos_le_one _) ?_
  intro hcos
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hcos
  apply hx
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  have htwoPi : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ htwoPi
  calc
    2 * Real.pi * (z : ℝ) = (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
    _ = 2 * Real.pi * x := by simpa [mul_assoc] using hz

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shiftedTheta_lt_of_not_integer
statement:
lemma shiftedTheta_lt_of_not_integer {p x : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (hx : ¬ ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = x) :
    shiftedTheta p x < gaussianTheta p
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < Real.log p := Real.log_pos hp
  have hzero : (∑' z : ℤ, Real.exp (-Real.log p * (z : ℝ) ^ 2)) =
      1 / (Real.log p / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ∑' k : ℤ, Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using shifted_gaussian_fourier hA 0
  rw [shiftedTheta, gaussianTheta, shifted_gaussian_fourier hA x, hzero]
  let w : ℤ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2)
  have hw : Summable w := summable_int_gaussian (by positivity)
  have hwcos : Summable (fun k : ℤ ↦
      w k * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x)) := by
    exact hw.of_norm_bounded (fun k ↦ by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      simpa [w] using mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        (Real.abs_cos_le_one (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x)))
  have hpoint : ∀ k : ℤ,
      w k * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x) ≤ w k := fun k ↦
    by
      dsimp only [w]
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.cos_le_one (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * x))
        (Real.exp_nonneg ((-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p)) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2))
  have hstrict : w 1 * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * x) < w 1 := by
    have hc := cos_two_pi_lt_one_of_not_integer hx
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc (Real.exp_pos
      (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2))
    simpa [w, mul_assoc] using this
  have hsum := hwcos.tsum_lt_tsum hpoint hstrict hw
  have hpref : 0 < 1 / (Real.log p / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  simpa [w] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsum hpref

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shiftedTheta_eq_of_integer
statement:
lemma shiftedTheta_eq_of_integer {p x : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (hx : ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = x) :
    shiftedTheta p x = gaussianTheta p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hA : 0 < Real.log p := Real.log_pos hp
  have hzero : (∑' y : ℤ, Real.exp (-Real.log p * (y : ℝ) ^ 2)) =
      1 / (Real.log p / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ∑' k : ℤ, Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / Real.log p) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using shifted_gaussian_fourier hA 0
  rw [shiftedTheta, gaussianTheta, shifted_gaussian_fourier hA (z : ℝ), hzero]
  apply congrArg (fun t : ℝ ↦
    1 / (Real.log p / Real.pi) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t)
  apply tsum_congr
  intro k
  have hcos := Real.cos_int_mul_two_pi (k * z)
  have : Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (z : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    convert hcos using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  rw [this, mul_one]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.shiftedTheta_eq_iff
statement:
lemma shiftedTheta_eq_iff {p x : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    shiftedTheta p x = gaussianTheta p ↔ ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hx
    exact (shiftedTheta_lt_of_not_integer hp hx).ne h
  · exact shiftedTheta_eq_of_integer hp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.finiteThetaSum_lt
statement:
lemma finiteThetaSum_lt {p L : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    finiteThetaSum p L <
      sharpConstant p * Real.exp (Real.log p * L ^ 2 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : 1 < p := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log p := Real.log_pos hp1
  let N := Nat.floor L + 1
  let center : ℝ := L / 2
  let g : ℤ → ℝ := fun z ↦ Real.exp (-Real.log p * ((z : ℝ) - center) ^ 2)
  have hg : Summable g := shiftedTheta_summable hp1
  have hfirst : finiteThetaSum p L <
      eulerC p * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range N,
        Real.exp (Real.log p * (r : ℝ) * (L - r)) := by
    unfold finiteThetaSum
    simp only [N]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun r hr ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hp r).le
        (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    · refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (gammaR_inv_lt_eulerC hp 0) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hcomplete :
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N,
        Real.exp (Real.log p * (r : ℝ) * (L - r))) =
        Real.exp (Real.log p * L ^ 2 / 4) *
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, g (r : ℤ) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [g, center, Int.cast_natCast]
    ring
  have hfinite_gauss : (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, g (r : ℤ)) ≤ ∑' z : ℤ, g z := by
    let emb : ℕ ↪ ℤ := ⟨Int.ofNat, Int.ofNat_injective⟩
    let s : Finset ℤ := (Finset.range N).map emb
    have hs : (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, g (r : ℤ)) = ∑ z ∈ s, g z := by
      simp [s, emb]
    rw [hs]
    exact hg.sum_le_tsum s (fun z hz ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have htheta : (∑' z : ℤ, g z) ≤ gaussianTheta p := by
    simpa [g, center, shiftedTheta] using shiftedTheta_le (p := p) (x := center) hp1
  calc
    finiteThetaSum p L
        < eulerC p * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range N,
            Real.exp (Real.log p * (r : ℝ) * (L - r)) := hfirst
    _ = eulerC p * (Real.exp (Real.log p * L ^ 2 / 4) *
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, g (r : ℤ)) := by rw [hcomplete]
    _ ≤ eulerC p * (Real.exp (Real.log p * L ^ 2 / 4) * gaussianTheta p) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfinite_gauss.trans htheta) (Real.exp_nonneg _))
        (eulerC_pos hp).le
    _ = sharpConstant p * Real.exp (Real.log p * L ^ 2 / 4) := by
      simp [sharpConstant]
      ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.natFloor_indexLog
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natFloor_indexLog (q n : ℕ) :
    Nat.floor (indexLog q n) = Nat.log q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [indexLog, Real.log_div_log, Real.natFloor_logb_natCast]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.indexLog_nonneg
statement:
theorem indexLog_nonneg {q n : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 ≤ indexLog q n
proof:
:= by
  have hqR : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne')
  exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hnR) (Real.log_pos hqR).le

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.ratCast_gammaQ_eq_gammaR
statement:
theorem ratCast_gammaQ_eq_gammaR (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ((gammaQ q r : ℚ) : ℝ) = gammaR (q : ℝ) r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [gammaR]
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [gammaQ_succ q r hq]
      rw [gammaR, Finset.prod_range_succ]
      rw [gammaR] at ih
      push_cast
      rw [ih]
      congr 2
      norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.exp_log_band_term
statement:
theorem exp_log_band_term {q n r : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Real.exp
        (Real.log (q : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) * (indexLog q n - (r : ℝ))) =
      (n : ℝ) ^ r / (q : ℝ) ^ (r * r)
proof:
:= by
  have hqR : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hlogq : Real.log (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos hqR).ne'
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hexponent :
      Real.log (q : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) * (indexLog q n - (r : ℝ)) =
        (r : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ) -
          ((r * r : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ) := by
    unfold indexLog
    field_simp
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hexponent, Real.exp_sub]
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_nat_mul]
  rw [Real.exp_log hnR, Real.exp_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < q)]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.ratCast_finiteUQ_eq_finiteThetaSum
statement:
theorem ratCast_finiteUQ_eq_finiteThetaSum {q n : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    ((finiteUQ n q : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      finiteThetaSum (q : ℝ) (indexLog q n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteUQ, finiteThetaSum, natFloor_indexLog]
  push_cast
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun r ↦
    (n : ℝ) ^ r /
      (((gammaQ q r : ℚ) : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (r * r))
  change (∑ r : Fin (Nat.log q n + 1), f r.1) = _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f]
  unfold f
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  rw [exp_log_band_term hq hn, ← ratCast_gammaQ_eq_gammaR q r (by omega)]
  have hgamma : gammaQ q r ≠ 0 := (gammaQ_pos hq).ne'
  norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv, hgamma]
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_le_finiteThetaSum
statement:
theorem interval_card_le_finiteThetaSum {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
      finiteThetaSum (q : ℝ) (indexLog q H.index)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := finiteU_bound hn hq hqp
  have hR :
      (((Nat.card (interval H) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ((finiteUQ H.index q : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hQ
  rw [ratCast_finiteUQ_eq_finiteThetaSum hq (by omega)] at hR
  exact_mod_cast hR

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_lt_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem interval_card_lt_sharpConstant {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q ≤ H.index.minFac) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
      sharpConstant (q : ℝ) * sharpScale q H.index
proof:
:= by
  exact (interval_card_le_finiteThetaSum hn hq hqp).trans_lt
    (finiteThetaSum_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ q by omega))
      (indexLog_nonneg hq (by omega)))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.sharpScale_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem sharpScale_eq_rpow {q n : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hn : 0 < n) :
    sharpScale q n = (n : ℝ) ^ (indexLog q n / 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sharpScale, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn)]
  unfold indexLog
  have hqR : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hlogq : Real.log (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos hqR).ne'
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_lt_leastPrime
statement:
theorem interval_card_lt_leastPrime {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
      sharpConstant (H.index.minFac : ℝ) *
        sharpScale H.index.minFac H.index
proof:
:= by
  have hp : H.index.minFac.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  exact interval_card_lt_sharpConstant hn hp.one_lt le_rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_lt_leastPrime_rpow
statement:
theorem interval_card_lt_leastPrime_rpow {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
      sharpConstant (H.index.minFac : ℝ) *
        (H.index : ℝ) ^
          (indexLog H.index.minFac H.index / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : H.index.minFac.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  rw [← sharpScale_eq_rpow hp.one_lt (by omega)]
  exact interval_card_lt_leastPrime hn

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.finiteU_and_sharp_leastPrime
statement:
theorem finiteU_and_sharp_leastPrime {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    ((Nat.card (interval H) : ℚ) ≤
        finiteUQ H.index H.index.minFac) ∧
      (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
        sharpConstant (H.index.minFac : ℝ) *
          (H.index : ℝ) ^
            (indexLog H.index.minFac H.index / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : H.index.minFac.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  exact ⟨finiteU_bound hn hp.one_lt le_rfl,
    interval_card_lt_leastPrime_rpow hn⟩

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_lt_universal
statement:
theorem interval_card_lt_universal {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
      sharpConstant 2 * sharpScale 2 H.index
proof:
:= by
  have hp : H.index.minFac.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  exact interval_card_lt_sharpConstant hn (by norm_num) hp.two_le

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_lt_universal_rpow
statement:
theorem interval_card_lt_universal_rpow {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
      sharpConstant 2 * (H.index : ℝ) ^ (indexLog 2 H.index / 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sharpScale_eq_rpow (q := 2) (n := H.index) (by norm_num) (by omega)]
  exact interval_card_lt_universal hn

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.interval_card_lt_universal_decimal
statement:
theorem interval_card_lt_universal_decimal {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) <
      ((3685984401 : ℝ) / 500000000) *
        (H.index : ℝ) ^ (indexLog 2 H.index / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : 0 < (H.index : ℝ) ^ (indexLog 2 H.index / 4) := by positivity
  exact (interval_card_lt_universal_rpow hn).trans
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right sharpConstant_two_lt_decimal hscale)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementary_interval_bound_rpow
statement:
theorem elementary_interval_bound_rpow {H : Subgroup G} (hn : 1 < H.index) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
      (H.index : ℝ) ^ indexLog 2 H.index
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := elementary_interval_bound hn
  have hcast :
      (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
        (H.index : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 H.index := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  calc
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
        (H.index : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 H.index := hcast
    _ = (H.index : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 H.index : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    _ ≤ (H.index : ℝ) ^ indexLog 2 H.index := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ H.index by omega))
      rw [indexLog, Real.log_div_log]
      exact Real.natLog_le_logb H.index 2

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.elementary_interval_bound_rpow_all
statement:
theorem elementary_interval_bound_rpow_all (H : Subgroup G) :
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
      (H.index : ℝ) ^ indexLog 2 H.index
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := elementary_interval_bound_all H
  have hcast :
      (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
        (H.index : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 H.index := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hindex : 1 ≤ H.index :=
    Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite
  calc
    (Nat.card (interval H) : ℝ) ≤
        (H.index : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 H.index := hcast
    _ = (H.index : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 H.index : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    _ ≤ (H.index : ℝ) ^ indexLog 2 H.index := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast hindex)
      rw [indexLog, Real.log_div_log]
      exact Real.natLog_le_logb H.index 2

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.BranchingTree.branchProduct_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem branchProduct_zero (s : State) (z : Path Choice next 0 s) :
    branchProduct Choice next z = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases z
  rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.BranchingTree.leaf_product_bound
statement:
theorem leaf_product_bound [∀ s, Nonempty (Choice s)]
    (r : ℕ) (s : State) (q : ℚ)
    (hq : ∀ z : Path Choice next r s,
      q ≤ (branchProduct Choice next z : ℚ)) :
    q ≤ (Fintype.card (Path Choice next r s) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing s q with
  | zero =>
      have h := hq PUnit.unit
      simpa [Path, branchProduct] using h
  | succ r ih =>
      let b : ℕ := Fintype.card (Choice s)
      have hbNat : 0 < b := Fintype.card_pos
      have hb : (0 : ℚ) < (b : ℚ) := (Nat.cast_pos (α := ℚ)).2 hbNat
      have hchild : ∀ x : Choice s,
          q / (b : ℚ) ≤
            (Fintype.card (Path Choice next r (next s x)) : ℚ) := by
        intro x
        apply ih (s := next s x) (q := q / (b : ℚ))
        intro z
        apply (div_le_iff₀ hb).2
        let zx : Path Choice next (r + 1) s := by
          change Σ x : Choice s, Path Choice next r (next s x)
          exact ⟨x, z⟩
        have hz := hq zx
        change q ≤ ((Fintype.card (Choice s) *
          branchProduct Choice next z : ℕ) : ℚ) at hz
        simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, b, mul_comm] using hz
      calc
        q = ∑ _x : Choice s, q / (b : ℚ) := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
          rw [show Fintype.card (Choice s) = b by rfl]
          exact (mul_div_cancel₀ q hb.ne').symm
        _ ≤ ∑ x : Choice s,
            (Fintype.card (Path Choice next r (next s x)) : ℚ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _hx => hchild x
        _ = (Fintype.card (Path Choice next (r + 1) s) : ℚ) := by
          simp only [Path, Fintype.card_sigma, Nat.cast_sum]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.BranchingTree.leaf_product_bound_sameUniverse
statement:
theorem leaf_product_bound_sameUniverse {State : Type u}
    (Choice : State → Type u) [∀ s, Fintype (Choice s)]
    (next : ∀ s, Choice s → State) [∀ s, Nonempty (Choice s)]
    (r : ℕ) (s : State) (q : ℚ)
    (hq : ∀ z : Path Choice next r s,
      q ≤ (branchProduct Choice next z : ℚ)) :
    q ≤ (Fintype.card (Path Choice next r s) : ℚ)
proof:
:=
  leaf_product_bound Choice next r s q hq

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq (p n : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p n) = totalQBinom p n
proof:
:=
  elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq_totalQBinom p n

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index (p a : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] :
    (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index = p ^ (2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.index_bot]
  simp [ZMod.card]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index_minFac
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index_minFac (p a : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] (ha : 0 < a) :
    (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index.minFac = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index p a]
  exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).pow_minFac (by omega)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_indexLog_rpow_eq
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_indexLog_rpow_eq (p a : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] :
    (((⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index : ℝ) ^
        (indexLog p
          (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index / 4)) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (a * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index]
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  have hlog : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos hp).ne'
  rw [indexLog, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  change ((p : ℝ) ^ (2 * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ^
      ((((2 * a : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ) /
        Real.log (p : ℝ)) / 4) = (p : ℝ) ^ (a * a)
  rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hlog]
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
  rw [show ((2 * a : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((2 * a : ℕ) : ℝ) / 4) =
      ((a * a : ℕ) : ℝ) by
    push_cast
    ring]
  exact Real.rpow_natCast (p : ℝ) (a * a)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_indexLog_primePower
statement:
theorem manuscript_indexLog_primePower (p n : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    indexLog p (p ^ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hlog : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos hpR).ne'
  rw [indexLog, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ (n : ℝ) hlog

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_primePowerU_eq_ratCast_finiteUQ
statement:
theorem manuscript_primePowerU_eq_ratCast_finiteUQ
    (p n : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    primePowerU p n = ((finiteUQ (p ^ n) p : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ratCast_finiteUQ_eq_finiteThetaSum hp (pow_pos (by omega) _),
    manuscript_indexLog_primePower p n hp]
  rw [primePowerU, finiteThetaSum]
  simp only [Nat.floor_natCast]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun r : ℕ ↦
    (p : ℝ) ^ (r * (n - r)) * (gammaR (p : ℝ) r)⁻¹)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hrmem
  have hr : r ≤ n := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hrmem
    omega
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < p)
  rw [show Real.log (p : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) *
      ((n : ℝ) - (r : ℝ)) =
        Real.log (p : ℝ) * ((r * (n - r) : ℕ) : ℝ) by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hr]
    ring]
  have hexp : Real.exp
      (Real.log (p : ℝ) * ((r * (n - r) : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (r * (n - r)) := by
    rw [mul_comm, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hpR]
  rw [hexp]
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_even_rank_tendsto_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_even_rank_tendsto_sharpConstant
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
        (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (sharpConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq] using
    gaussian_even_rank_asymptotic (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_displayed_ratio_tendsto_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_displayed_ratio_tendsto_sharpConstant
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) /
        (((⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index : ℝ) ^
          (indexLog p
            (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index / 4)))
      atTop (nhds (sharpConstant (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply (manuscript_elementaryAbelian_even_rank_tendsto_sharpConstant
    (p := p)).congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a ↦ by
    dsimp only
    rw [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_indexLog_rpow_eq p a]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_primePowerU_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_primePowerU_tendsto_one
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) /
        primePowerU p (2 * a)) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq] using
    gaussian_total_div_primePowerU_tendsto_one (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_finiteUQ_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_finiteUQ_tendsto_one
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℕ ↦
      (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) /
        (((finiteUQ
          (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p (2 * a))).index p : ℚ) : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_div_primePowerU_tendsto_one
    (p := p)).congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a ↦ by
    dsimp only
    rw [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_bottom_index p a,
      manuscript_primePowerU_eq_ratCast_finiteUQ p (2 * a)
        (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_elementaryAbelian_bound
statement:
theorem manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_elementaryAbelian_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ a : ℕ,
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
        (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    sharpConstant (p : ℝ) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply sharpConstant_le_of_even_rank_bound (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
  intro a
  simpa only [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq] using hC a

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_positive_elementaryAbelian_bound
statement:
theorem manuscript_sharpConstant_le_of_positive_elementaryAbelian_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a →
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (a * a) *
        (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    sharpConstant (p : ℝ) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_tendsto
    (manuscript_elementaryAbelian_even_rank_tendsto_sharpConstant (p := p))
  exact Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun a ha ↦ hC a (by omega)⟩

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_no_subquarter_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
statement:
theorem manuscript_no_subquarter_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha : alpha < 1 / 4) :
    ¬ ∀ a : ℕ,
      (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) ≤
        C * Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (4 * alpha * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply no_subquarter_rpow_bound (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le halpha
  intro a
  simpa only [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq] using h a

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_no_subquarter_positive_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
statement:
theorem manuscript_no_subquarter_positive_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha : alpha < 1 / 4) :
    ¬ ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a →
      (Fintype.card (elementaryAbelianInterval p (2 * a)) : ℝ) ≤
        C * Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (4 * alpha * (a : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpositive
  apply manuscript_no_subquarter_elementaryAbelian_rpow_bound
    (p := p) (alpha := alpha) (C := max C 1) halpha
  intro a
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst a
    rw [manuscript_elementaryAbelian_interval_card_eq]
    simp [totalQBinom]
  · have haPos : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha
    have hpow : 0 ≤ Real.rpow (p : ℝ) (4 * alpha * (a : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    exact (hpositive a haPos).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left C 1) hpow)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_elementaryAbelian_fixed_layer_eq
statement:
theorem manuscript_elementaryAbelian_fixed_layer_eq (p n k : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (primePowerLayer p k
      (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p n)) ⊤).card = qBinom p n k
proof:
:=
  elementaryAbelian_primePowerLayer_card_eq_qBinom p n k hk

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_normal_elementaryAbelian_quotient_interval_card_eq
statement:
theorem manuscript_normal_elementaryAbelian_quotient_interval_card_eq
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] {p n : ℕ}
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal]
    (e : (G ⧸ H) ≃* ElementaryAbelianGroup p n) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype.card (Set.Ici H) = totalQBinom p n
proof:
:=
  normal_elementaryAbelian_quotient_interval_card_eq H e

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_generatedFrom_bot_eq_top_iff_addClosure
statement:
theorem manuscript_generatedFrom_bot_eq_top_iff_addClosure
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (x : Fin r → ElementaryAbelianGroup p r) :
    generatedFrom (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p r)) x = ⊤ ↔
      AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (fun i ↦ Multiplicative.toAdd (x i))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [generatedFrom, bot_sup_eq]
  have hrange : Multiplicative.ofAdd ⁻¹' Set.range x =
      Set.range (fun i ↦ Multiplicative.toAdd (x i)) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨i, congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hi⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg Subgroup.toAddSubgroup' h
    simpa [Subgroup.toAddSubgroup'_closure, hrange] using h'
  · intro h
    apply Subgroup.toAddSubgroup'.injective
    simpa [Subgroup.toAddSubgroup'_closure, hrange] using h

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.manuscript_cosetRelGen_elementaryAbelian_card_cast_eq_gammaR
statement:
theorem manuscript_cosetRelGen_elementaryAbelian_card_cast_eq_gammaR
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (Nat.card (CosetRelGen
      (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p r)) ⊤ r) : ℝ) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (r * r) * gammaR (p : ℝ) r
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := rawRelGen_card_eq_cosetRelGen_card_mul_cardH_pow
    (G := ElementaryAbelianGroup p r)
    (H := (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p r))) (K := ⊤) bot_le r
  have hcard : Nat.card (CosetRelGen
      (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p r)) ⊤ r) =
      Nat.card (GeneratingFramesFinZMod p r) := by
    calc
      Nat.card (CosetRelGen
          (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p r)) ⊤ r) =
          Nat.card (RawRelGen
            (⊥ : Subgroup (ElementaryAbelianGroup p r)) ⊤ r) := by
        simpa using hraw.symm
      _ = Nat.card (GeneratingFramesFinZMod p r) :=
        Nat.card_congr (manuscript_rawRelGenEquivGeneratingFrames p r)
  rw [hcard]
  exact card_generatingFrames_fin_zmod_cast_eq_gammaR p r

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_zero_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qBinom_zero_zero (q : ℕ) : qBinom q 0 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_zero_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem qBinom_zero_succ (q k : ℕ) : qBinom q 0 (k + 1) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_succ_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qBinom_succ_zero (q n : ℕ) : qBinom q (n + 1) 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem qBinom_succ_succ (q n k : ℕ) :
    qBinom q (n + 1) (k + 1) =
      qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1)
proof: := rfl

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt (q : ℕ) : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → qBinom q n k = 0
proof:
| 0, 0, h => by omega
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => by simp
  | _ + 1, 0, h => by omega
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
      rw [qBinom_succ_succ]
      have hnk : n < k := by omega
      have hnks : n < k + 1 := by omega
      simp [qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hnk, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hnks]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_self
statement: @[simp] theorem qBinom_self (q : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, qBinom q n n = 1
proof:
| 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [qBinom_succ_succ]
      simp [qBinom_self q n, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_pascal
statement:
theorem qBinom_pascal (q : ℕ) {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    qBinom q n k = qBinom q (n - 1) (k - 1) + q ^ k * qBinom q (n - 1) k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
  simpa using qBinom_succ_succ q n k

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qFactorial_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qFactorial_zero (q : ℕ) : qFactorial q 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [qFactorial]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qFactorial_succ
statement:
theorem qFactorial_succ (q n : ℕ) :
    qFactorial q (n + 1) = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qFactorial, Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qFactorial_pos
statement: theorem qFactorial_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (n : ℕ) : 0 < qFactorial q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [qFactorial]
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun i hi ↦ by
    have hiq : 1 < q ^ (i + 1) := by
      exact one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    omega

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one
statement:
private theorem pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one {q a b : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (q ^ a - 1) + q ^ a * (q ^ b - 1) = q ^ (a + b) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 1 ≤ q ^ a := one_le_pow₀ hq
  have hb : 1 ≤ q ^ b := one_le_pow₀ hq
  have hab : q ^ a ≤ q ^ a * q ^ b := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (q ^ a) hb
  rw [pow_add, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, mul_one, add_comm]
  exact tsub_add_tsub_cancel hab ha

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_mul_qFactorials
statement:
theorem qBinom_mul_qFactorials {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    ∀ {n k : ℕ}, k ≤ n →
      qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) = qFactorial q n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst k
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
          have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
          by_cases htop : k = n
          · subst k
            rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qBinom_self,
              qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
            simp [qFactorial_succ]
          · have hklt : k < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hkn htop
            have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ n := by omega
            have hsub : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
            rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qFactorial_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, hsub,
              qFactorial_succ]
            calc
              (qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1)) *
                    (qFactorial q k * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1)) *
                    (qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) * (q ^ (n - (k + 1) + 1) - 1)) =
                  (qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) *
                      (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                    q ^ (k + 1) *
                      (qBinom q n (k + 1) * qFactorial q (k + 1) *
                        qFactorial q (n - (k + 1))) *
                      (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
                        rw [qFactorial_succ, hsub, qFactorial_succ]
                        ring
              _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                    q ^ (k + 1) * qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
                      rw [ih hkn, ih hk1]
              _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by
                    have hexp : k + 1 + (n - k) = n + 1 := by omega
                    calc
                      qFactorial q n * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                          q ^ (k + 1) * qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) =
                          qFactorial q n * ((q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                            q ^ (k + 1) * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)) := by ring
                      _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ ((k + 1) + (n - k)) - 1) := by
                        rw [pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one (by omega)]
                      _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by rw [hexp]
              _ = qFactorial q (n + 1) := by rw [qFactorial_succ]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_symm
statement:
theorem qBinom_symm {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    qBinom q n k = qBinom q n (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  have hright := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq (Nat.sub_le n k)
  rw [tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le hk] at hright
  have hden : 0 < qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) :=
    Nat.mul_pos (qFactorial_pos hq k) (qFactorial_pos hq (n - k))
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hden
  calc
    qBinom q n k * (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) = qFactorial q n := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hleft
    _ = qBinom q n (n - k) * (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hright.symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_cast_eq_qFactorial_div
statement:
theorem qBinom_cast_eq_qFactorial_div {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (qBinom q n k : ℚ) =
      qFactorial q n / (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k))
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt
      (Nat.mul_pos (qFactorial_pos hq k) (qFactorial_pos hq (n - k))))
  apply (eq_div_iff hden).2
  simpa [mul_assoc] using (show
    (qBinom q n k : ℚ) * (qFactorial q k : ℚ) *
      (qFactorial q (n - k) : ℚ) = (qFactorial q n : ℚ) by
        exact_mod_cast qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.span_coe_frame_eq_submodule
statement:
private theorem span_coe_frame_eq_submodule
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (k : ℕ) (W : Submodule K V) (s : Fin k → W)
    (hs : LinearIndependent K s) (hW : Module.finrank K W = k) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ (s i : V)) = W
proof:
:= by
  have htop : Submodule.span K (Set.range s) = ⊤ :=
    hs.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by simp [hW])
  change Submodule.span K (Set.range (W.subtype ∘ s)) = W
  rw [Set.range_comp, ← Submodule.map_span, htop, Submodule.map_top,
    Submodule.range_subtype]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameProd_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem frameProd_zero (q n : ℕ) : frameProd q n 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [frameProd]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameProd_succ
statement:
theorem frameProd_succ (q n k : ℕ) :
    frameProd q n (k + 1) = frameProd q n k * (q ^ n - q ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameProd, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp [frameProd]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.framePower_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem framePower_zero (q : ℕ) : framePower q 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [framePower]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.framePower_succ
statement:
theorem framePower_succ (q k : ℕ) :
    framePower q (k + 1) = framePower q k * q ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [framePower, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp [framePower]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub
statement:
private theorem pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub {q n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    q ^ n - q ^ k = q ^ k * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 1 [show n = k + (n - k) by omega]
  rw [pow_add, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
  simp

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameProd_mul_qFactorial
statement:
theorem frameProd_mul_qFactorial {q n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k) =
      framePower q k * qFactorial q n
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
      have hsub : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [frameProd_succ, pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub hkn, framePower_succ]
      calc
        frameProd q n k * (q ^ k * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)) *
              qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) =
            q ^ k * (frameProd q n k *
              (qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) * (q ^ (n - k) - 1))) := by ring
        _ = q ^ k * (frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
          rw [hsub, qFactorial_succ]
        _ = q ^ k * (framePower q k * qFactorial q n) := by rw [ih hkn]
        _ = framePower q k * q ^ k * qFactorial q n := by ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.qBinom_mul_frameProd
statement:
theorem qBinom_mul_frameProd {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    qBinom q n k * frameProd q k k = frameProd q n k
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := q) (n := n) hk
  have hdiag := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := q) (n := k) (le_refl k)
  have hqbin := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, qFactorial_zero, mul_one] at hdiag
  have hcancel : 0 < qFactorial q (n - k) := qFactorial_pos hq _
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hcancel
  calc
    qBinom q n k * frameProd q k k * qFactorial q (n - k) =
        framePower q k *
          (qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
            rw [hdiag]
            ring
    _ = framePower q k * qFactorial q n := by rw [hqbin]
    _ = frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k) := hmain.symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.frameProd_pos
statement:
theorem frameProd_pos {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    0 < frameProd q n k
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameProd]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i hi
  have hik : i.val < k := i.isLt
  have hin : i.val < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hik hk
  exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hin)

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_linearIndependentFrames
statement:
theorem card_linearIndependentFrames
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K V k) =
      frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [frameProd] using card_linearIndependent (K := K) (V := V) hk

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_orderedBases_fin_zmod
statement:
theorem card_orderedBases_fin_zmod (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames (ZMod p) (Fin r → ZMod p) r) =
      frameProd p r r
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    (card_linearIndependentFrames
      (K := ZMod p) (V := Fin r → ZMod p) (k := r) (by simp))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd
statement:
theorem card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
      frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (FinrankSubspaces K V k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  calc
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
        ∑ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    _ = ∑ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
          Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro W hW
        symm
        simpa [W.2] using
          (card_linearIndependentFrames (K := K) (V := W.1) (k := k)
            (by simp [W.2]))
    _ = Nat.card (Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
          LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) := Nat.card_sigma.symm
    _ = Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K V k) :=
      Nat.card_congr (linearIndependentFramesEquiv K V k).symm
    _ = frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k :=
      card_linearIndependentFrames hk

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
statement:
theorem card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) =
      qBinom (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 2 ≤ Fintype.card K := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have hpos : 0 < frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := frameProd_pos hq le_rfl
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpos
  calc
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
        frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k :=
      card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd hk
    _ = qBinom (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k *
        frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := (qBinom_mul_frameProd hq hk).symm

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_subspaces_fin_zmod
statement:
theorem card_subspaces_fin_zmod (p n k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Nat.card {W : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) //
      Module.finrank (ZMod p) W = k} = qBinom p n k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    (card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
      (K := ZMod p) (V := Fin n → ZMod p) (k := k) (by simpa using hk))

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.totalQBinom_even_split
statement:
theorem totalQBinom_even_split {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (a : ℕ) :
    totalQBinom q (2 * a) = qBinom q (2 * a) a +
      2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, qBinom q (2 * a) (a + (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun k ↦ qBinom q (2 * a) k
  have hlow : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + (j + 1)) := by
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f j) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a - 1 - j) :=
        (Finset.sum_range_reflect f a).symm
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + (j + 1)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hja : j < a := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        dsimp [f]
        rw [qBinom_symm hq (by omega : a - 1 - j ≤ 2 * a)]
        congr 1
        omega
  rw [totalQBinom, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  have hsize : 2 * a + 1 = (a + 1) + a := by omega
  rw [hsize, Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_range_succ, hlow]
  dsimp [f]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]
  ring

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod
statement:
theorem card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)) = totalQBinom p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (submoduleEquivSigmaFinrank (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)),
    Nat.card_sigma]
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) = n := by simp
  rw [hfin]
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : Fin (n + 1), Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) k.val)) =
        ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), qBinom p n k.val := by
    apply Fintype.sum_congr
    intro k
    exact card_subspaces_fin_zmod p n k.val (by omega)
  simpa only [totalQBinom] using hsum

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.generatedFrom_mul_right
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sup_le le_sup_left
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
    apply (generatedFrom H x).mul_mem
    · exact (show Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) ≤ generatedFrom H x from
        le_sup_right) (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact (show H ≤ generatedFrom H x from le_sup_left) (h i).2
  · apply sup_le le_sup_left
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hxmul : x i * (h i : G) ∈
        Subgroup.closure (Set.range (fun j => x j * (h j : G))) :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hh : ((h i : H) : G)⁻¹ ∈ H := H.inv_mem (h i).2
    have hprod : (x i * (h i : G)) * (h i : G)⁻¹ ∈
        generatedFrom H (fun j => x j * (h j : G)) :=
      (generatedFrom H (fun j => x j * (h j : G))).mul_mem
        ((show Subgroup.closure (Set.range (fun j => x j * (h j : G))) ≤
            generatedFrom H (fun j => x j * (h j : G)) from le_sup_right) hxmul)
        ((show H ≤ generatedFrom H (fun j => x j * (h j : G)) from
            le_sup_left) hh)
    simpa [generatedFrom] using hprod

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.cosetRep_mul_cosetAdjustment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cosetRep_mul_cosetAdjustment (H K : Subgroup G) (b : K) :
    ((Quotient.out (QuotientGroup.mk b : K ⧸ H.subgroupOf K) : K) : G) *
        (cosetAdjustment H K b : G) = (b : G)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cosetAdjustment]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.generatedFrom_cosetRep_raw
proof:
:= by
  let h : Fin r → H := fun i =>
    cosetAdjustment H K ⟨x.1 i, x.2.1 i⟩
  have htuple :
      (fun i => cosetRepTuple H K (rawCosetTuple H K x) i * (h i : G)) =
        x.1 := by
    funext i
    exact cosetRep_mul_cosetAdjustment H K ⟨x.1 i, x.2.1 i⟩
  rw [← generatedFrom_mul_right H
    (cosetRepTuple H K (rawCosetTuple H K x)) h, htuple, x.2.2]

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.rawCosetTuple_cosetRelGenProdToRaw
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  let a : K := Quotient.out (z.1.1 i)
  let b : K := ⟨(a : G) * (z.2 i : G),
    K.mul_mem a.2 (hHK (z.2 i).2)⟩
  change QuotientGroup.mk b = z.1.1 i
  calc
    QuotientGroup.mk b = QuotientGroup.mk a := by
      apply Quotient.sound'
      apply QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr
      apply Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr
      change ((a : G) * (z.2 i : G))⁻¹ * (a : G) ∈ H
      simpa using H.inv_mem (z.2 i).2
    _ = z.1.1 i := Quotient.out_eq' _

name: SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.cosetAdjustment_reconstructed
statement:
theorem cosetAdjustment_reconstructed {H K : Subgroup G}
    (hHK : H ≤ K) (q : K ⧸ H.subgroupOf K) (h : H) :
    cosetAdjustment H K
        ⟨((Quotient.out q : K) : G) * (h : G),
          K.mul_mem (Quotient.out q : K).2 (hHK h.2)⟩ = h
proof:
:= by
  let a : K := Quotient.out q
  let b : K := ⟨(a : G) * (h : G), K.mul_mem a.2 (hHK h.2)⟩
  have hmk :
      (QuotientGroup.mk b : K ⧸ H.subgroupOf K) = q := by
    calc
      QuotientGroup.mk b = QuotientGroup.mk a := by
        apply Quotient.sound'
        apply QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr
        apply Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr
        change ((a : G) * (h : G))⁻¹ * (a : G) ∈ H
        simpa using H.inv_mem h.2
      _ = q := Quotient.out_eq' _
  have hout :
      Quotient.out (QuotientGroup.mk b : K ⧸ H.subgroupOf K) = a := by
    exact congrArg Quotient.out hmk
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (((Quotient.out (QuotientGroup.mk b : K ⧸ H.subgroupOf K) : K)⁻¹ *
    b : K) : G) = (h : G)
  rw [hout]
  simp [b]
